Badge «أدخل عدد المستفيدين في المقترح» when missing.
- Tests: other program's indicator rejected; institutional accepted; code taken from library not from the request; `target_population` default.

## Scope
### In scope
- **Indicators & Targets** tab on `resources/views/pages/proposals/⚡show.blade.php`. Recommended: keep the existing tab key `targets` (deep links and `warnings()` use it) and change its label and content; confirm in plan mode.
  1. Library checklist: active library entries, grouped by `suggested_level`, searchable in Arabic and English via `App\Support\Like::contains`.
  2. Ticking an entry asks for a framework node from this proposal's framework at a compatible level, then creates an `indicators` row (instance) linked to that result and to the library entry.
  3. Targets grid: rows = indicator instances in the proposal framework, columns = linked projects; each cell holds a value and a period and maps to one `plan_indicators` row (`source_type = 'proposal'`, `source_id = proposal id`, `project_id = center`, `target = value`).
  4. Beside each cell: last year's achievement when the proposal is a renewal (Task 10), read through `achievedValue()`.
- **Project** page (`resources/views/pages/projects/⚡show.blade.php`): a read-only list of the project's indicators from its proposals and from its program framework, plus a MEAL action to scope a program-framework indicator to the project (`indicators.project_id`). Recommended: extend the existing `targets` tab; confirm in plan mode.
- Create `app/Actions/Indicators/AttachLibraryIndicatorToResult.php`, `app/Actions/Indicators/DetachIndicatorFromResult.php`, `app/Actions/Targets/SaveProposalTargetsGrid.php`.
- Create the grid component `resources/views/components/ui/targets-grid.blade.php` (Blade + Alpine keyboard navigation).
- Column headers show the HR center name and city (Task 30), falling back to the project name.
- One digest event per grid save registered in the Task 21 `EventCatalog` (MEAL + General Management).
- Lang keys in `lang/en/targets.php` + `lang/ar/targets.php` (and `proposals.php` / `projects.php` for tab labels).
- Open question, not a default: the plan relies on "the existing unique constraint" on `plan_indicators`, but the schema has only an index on `(source_type, source_id)`; duplicates are blocked in application code only (`targets/⚡index` `saveTarget()`). Propose a migration adding a unique index on `(source_type, source_id, indicator_id, project_id)` with a duplicate pre-check that aborts and prints offending ids. Add it only after the developer approves.
### Out of scope
Library CRUD and seeding (Task 11); framework editing, `ResultType::Activity`, milestone links (Task 12); renewal cloning and prior-year suggestion source (Task 10); full chain view (Task 16); monthly report lines (Task 17); **Monthly Matrix** and cross-donor aggregation (Task 18); guided tours and user guide (Task 26).

## Business rules
- Unticking (detach) deletes the indicator instance only when it has no `plan_indicators`; otherwise reject with a message stating the target count (`trans_choice`, Arabic plural ranges).
- Empty cell = no target for that center. Cell with `0` = a target of zero (allowed).
- Every cell passes `PlanIndicator::chainIssuesFor()` (project funded by the proposal; indicator in a consistent framework). Reject only issues the save introduces, as `saveTarget()` does today.
- No duplicate target for the same source + indicator + project.
- Once a target has reports, its indicator and source are locked; value and period stay editable.
- Percentage indicators: value <= 100.
- The same target for two donors is entered separately per proposal; aggregation is Task 18.
- Rejected proposal (`ProposalStatus::Rejected`): grid and checklist are read-only.
- Deactivated library entry: stays on proposals that use it, never offered for new ticks.
- Level compatibility: the chosen result's `type` equals the library entry's `suggested_level` when set; any level when it is null.
- Clearing a cell that already has a saved target deletes that target only if it has no reports and the user holds `targets.delete`; otherwise the batch is rejected. (Inferred from "empty = no target"; confirm in plan mode.)

## Security and authorization
- Attach: `indicators.create`. Detach: `indicators.delete` (confirm in plan mode; Managers hold create but not delete). Grid: `targets.create` for new cells, `targets.update` for changed cells, `targets.delete` for cleared cells. `proposals.update` alone grants nothing here (D-23). Other viewers get the read-only tab.
- Each Action calls `Gate::authorize` itself; the component re-checks for UI only.
- BOLA: load the result through the proposal scope (`Result::query()->where('proposal_id', $proposal->id)->whereKey($resultId)`), projects through `$proposal->projects()->whereKey($ids)`, indicators through results of this proposal's framework, existing targets through `source_type = 'proposal'` + `source_id`. Any id outside these sets rejects the whole batch; never trust ids or versions held in Livewire state.
- `libraryIndicatorId` must exist and be active.
- No money in this tab: do not load agreements, budgets or transfers.
- Audit: `Indicator` and `PlanIndicator` already implement `TracksActivity`. A grid save of many cells records one activity per row; decide in plan mode whether that notification volume is acceptable or whether the batch should be quiet (`Activity::withoutRecording`) with one summary event. Default: keep per-row activity.

## Validation
Messages in `lang/en/targets.php` and `lang/ar/targets.php`, grouped per module, never inline text.
- `cells`: array. `cells.*.indicatorId`, `cells.*.projectId`: required, integer (membership checked in the Action).
- `cells.*.value`: nullable, numeric, min:0, max:9999999999.99 (`decimal(12,2)`), and max:100 for percentage indicators — "القيمة لا تكون سالبة" / "Value cannot be negative"; "النسبة لا تتجاوز 100" / "A percentage cannot exceed 100".
- `cells.*.period`: required_with:value, `Rule::enum(Period::class)`.
- `cells.*.version`: nullable string (the target's `updated_at` when loaded).
- `resultId` on attach: required, in this proposal's framework, compatible level — "اختر نتيجة من إطار هذا المقترح بمستوى متوافق" / English equivalent.
- `libraryIndicatorId`: required, active library entry.
- Stale cell: "عُدّلت هذه القيمة من مستخدم آخر" / "Another user changed this value; reload".

## Edge cases and concurrency
- Two users saving the grid: compare each loaded target's `updated_at` (version) with the stored one inside the transaction after `lockForUpdate`. The plan says "reject that row"; section 5 says "reject the whole batch". Default: reject the whole batch and flag the stale cells (no partial save); confirm in plan mode.
- Double submit: the second save finds identical values and writes nothing new; no duplicate rows.
- Attaching the same library entry twice under one result: `indicators` has a unique `(result_id, name)`; treat as "already attached", not a 500.
- Library `frequency` uses `CollectionFrequency` (Task 11) while `indicators.frequency` uses `Period`; map known values and fall back to the column default for `one-time` / `midline-endline`. State the mapping in plan mode.
- Project unlinked after targets were entered: rows stay and are flagged inconsistent (existing behaviour), never deleted.
- Permission removed mid-session: the Action re-checks and returns 403.
- Inactive HR owner of a center: irrelevant to targets; do not block.

## Data integrity
- `SaveProposalTargetsGrid` runs in one `DB::transaction`: lock the proposal row, validate every cell, then upsert. Any failing cell rejects the batch and returns the list of offending cells; nothing is written.
- Upsert per cell by (source, indicator, project) through Eloquent (`firstOrNew` + `save`) so `RecordsActivity` and observers fire; never `DB::table()->upsert()`.
- `plan_indicators.indicator_id` cascades and `project_id` is `nullOnDelete` (existing); detach deletes the instance through Eloquent only.
- If the unique index migration is approved: pre-check duplicates before DDL, `utf8mb4_unicode_ci`/InnoDB DYNAMIC, a working `down()`.

## Implementation guidance
- `declare(strict_types=1);`, typed signatures, PHPDoc array shapes. Actions are plain classes with `handle()` like their siblings. Skeleton:
```php
class SaveProposalTargetsGrid
{
    /**
     * @param  list<array{indicatorId: int, projectId: int, value: ?string, period: ?string, version: ?string}>  $cells
     * @return array{created: int, updated: int, deleted: int}
     *
     * @throws ValidationException naming every offending cell; nothing is written
     */
    public function handle(Proposal $proposal, array $cells): array {}
}
```
- Show achievement only through `achievedValue()` / `percentAchieved()` with `reports` and `indicator` eager loaded; never a local formula.
- Load the grid in a fixed number of queries (proposal, projects, framework results + indicators + library entries, targets with reports, prior-year targets), then shape it in PHP. Call one `forget…()` helper that unsets every affected computed after a write.
- Flux modals bound with `wire:model` to a boolean, never `:open`. Reuse `x-ui.*` components (`x-ui.panel`, `x-ui.empty-state`, `x-ui.button`, `x-ui.enum-badge`). Library codes render LTR-isolated; names use `dir="auto"`; show the name in the user's locale with the other language as a secondary line.
- Grid: logical spacing (`ps-*`/`pe-*`), arrow-key and Enter navigation in Alpine, labelled inputs, status not conveyed by colour alone, `wire:model` deferred until Save.
- No `@php(...)` shorthand in Blade.

## Tests (Pest)
Follow `.ai/rules/tests.md`: seed `RolesAndPermissionsSeeder`, use `User::factory()->role(...)` or `userWithRole()`, and a fresh Livewire instance for each forbidden call.
- `tests/Feature/ProposalIndicatorSelectionTest.php`: attach creates an instance under the chosen node with the right `library_indicator_id`; incompatible level rejected; inactive entry hidden and rejected; result from another proposal's framework rejected (BOLA); detach with targets rejected with the count; detach without targets succeeds; 403 without `indicators.create`.
- `tests/Feature/ProposalTargetsGridTest.php`: saves one target per center; empty cell creates no row; `0` creates a row; cell for an unlinked project rejects the whole batch and writes nothing; indicator outside the framework rejects the batch; percentage > 100 rejected; stale version rejected; double submit creates no duplicates; rejected proposal is read-only; a `concept note` proposal accepts targets (Revision 2); column headers show the HR center name and city; user without `targets.create` sees the grid read-only and gets 403 on save; query count is equal for 3 and 30 cells.
- `tests/Feature/ProjectIndicatorsTest.php`: the project page lists indicators from its proposals and its program framework; MEAL scopes a program indicator to the project; a project outside the result's program is rejected.
- Arabic render of the tab (labels from `lang/ar`), and `tests/Feature/LocalizationTest.php` stays green.
Run `php artisan test --compact tests/Feature/ProposalTargetsGridTest.php` (and each file / `--filter=...`), plus `tests/Feature/TargetDirectoryTest.php`, `tests/Feature/ProposalDetailTest.php`, `tests/Feature/ProjectDetailTest.php`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] MEAL selects indicators from the library and enters targets for every center of a proposal from one screen.
- [ ] A grid save is atomic: any invalid or foreign cell leaves the database unchanged.
- [ ] Holders of `proposals.update` without `targets.*` cannot change targets (403 test).
- [ ] The **Project** page shows its indicators from proposals and from the program framework.
- [ ] Achievement figures come only from `achievedValue()` / `percentAchieved()`.
- [ ] Targets can be entered before approval (from `concept note`), and the grid is complete before CP3 (end of day 9).
- [ ] Query count of the tab is flat (test).
- [ ] Every new string exists in `lang/en` and `lang/ar`; the tab renders correctly in RTL.

## Do not
- Compute achievement with a local formula in the grid.
- Save the grid partially.
- Let any `proposals.update` holder edit targets.
- Copy library fields into `indicators` as a second source of truth (only `name` is filled, per Task 11).
- Write targets through the query builder (bypasses activity and observers).
- Bind a Flux modal with `:open`, or use `@php(...)` shorthand.
- Add the unique index, a new dependency or a new base folder without approval.

## Working method
- Start in plan mode: restate the task in 5 bullets, list files you will touch, list open questions; wait for approval.
- Implement in small steps; after each step run the narrowest relevant tests.
- Run `vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent` after PHP changes.
- If you discover a durable rule or trap, record it with the Boost `record-rule` tool (not native memory).
- Do not commit, push, or run destructive commands (`migrate:fresh`, seeders that reset roles, deleting storage) unless the developer asks.
- Never run anything against production.
- Stay inside this task's scope; note anything else as a follow-up.

## Report back
Your final message must contain: a summary; files changed; migrations added (if any); tests run with pass/fail output; decisions assumed (D-11, D-23, D-24, D-25 and the open questions above); follow-ups (e.g. prior-year column waiting on Task 10). Handoff facts: for Task 16 (chain view) and Task 18 (**Monthly Matrix**), where per-center targets live (`plan_indicators`, `source_type = 'proposal'`, `project_id` = center) and whether the unique index exists; for Task 17 (monthly report lines) and Task 19 (aggregated donor reports), how targets per project and period are read; the exact Action names and `handle()` signatures.

Objective

تطبيق «List with checks» و«One Donor (One Proposal) → Multiple projects (Centers) · Same Indicators · Targets & Indicators لكل مركز» و«Target from MEAL by indicator»: يختار MEAL مؤشرات المقترح من المكتبة بالتحديد، ثم يُدخل مستهدفًا لكل مركز (مشروع).

Implementation scope

  • تبويب Indicators & Targets في صفحة Proposal:
    1. قائمة المكتبة بمربعات اختيار، مجمّعة بالمستوى المقترح، مع بحث.
    2. عند التحديد: اختيار عقدة الإطار (من إطار المقترح وبمستوى متوافق)، فيُنشأ indicators (instance) مرتبط بها وبالمكتبة.
    3. شبكة المستهدفات: صفوف المؤشرات × أعمدة المشاريع المرتبطة، لكل خلية قيمة وفترة، فتُنشأ plan_indicators (source = proposal، project_id = المركز).
    4. بجانب كل خلية: إنجاز السنة السابقة إن كان المقترح تجديدًا (Task 10).
  • في صفحة Project: قائمة للقراءة بمؤشرات المشروع (من مقترحاته ومن إطار برنامجه)، وتحديد MEAL لمؤشرات إطار البرنامج الخاصة بالمشروع (indicators.project_id).

Required deliverables

  • Actions: AttachLibraryIndicatorToResult، DetachIndicatorFromResult، SaveProposalTargetsGrid (حفظ الشبكة دفعة واحدة).
  • مكوّن الشبكة (Blade + Alpine للتنقل بلوحة المفاتيح).
  • اختبارات.

Business rules

  • إلغاء تحديد مؤشر: يحذف الـ instance فقط إن لم تكن عليه مستهدفات، وإلا يُرفض برسالة تذكر عدد المستهدفات.
  • خلية فارغة = لا مستهدف لهذا المركز. خلية بصفر = مستهدف بصفر (مسموح).
  • سلسلة الاتساق القائمة (PlanIndicator::chainIssuesFor) تُطبَّق على كل خلية: المشروع ممول بالمقترح، والمؤشر في إطار متسق.
  • لا مستهدف مكرر للمصدر والمؤشر والمشروع نفسه (القيد القائم).
  • بعد وصول تقرير على المستهدف يُقفل مؤشره ومصدره، وتبقى القيمة والفترة قابلتين للتعديل (القاعدة القائمة).
  • النسبة المئوية ≤ 100.
  • «نفس الـ Target لمانحَين»: الإدخال منفصل لكل مقترح (مانح)، والعرض المجمّع في Task 18.

Security and permissions

  • التحديد والمستهدفات: targets.create/update + indicators.create لـ MEAL فقط (وSuper Admin تلقائيًا). GM وManagers والمعنيون الآخرون عرض فقط (D-23، المراجعة 6).
  • الشبكة تُحفظ في الخادم بالتحقق من كل خلية: project_id ضمن مشاريع المقترح، وindicator_id ضمن إطار المقترح. أي معرّف خارجها يرفض الدفعة كلها (منع BOLA).
  • لا مال في هذا التبويب.

Validation rules

  • cells.*.value: nullable, numeric, min:0، وmax:100 للنسبة — «القيمة لا تكون سالبة» / «النسبة لا تتجاوز 100».
  • cells.*.period: required_with:value, Enum(Period).
  • resultId عند التحديد: من إطار المقترح وبمستوى متوافق مع suggested_level، أو أي مستوى إن لم يُقترح.

Exceptional and edge cases

  • حفظ متزامن للشبكة من مستخدمَين: الحفظ لكل خلية upsert بالقيد الفريد. يُستعمل updated_at للمستهدف كإصدار، فإن تغيّر منذ التحميل يُرفض ذلك الصف ويُعرض «عُدّلت هذه القيمة من مستخدم آخر».
  • مشروع فُك ربطه بعد إدخال مستهدفاته: الصفوف تُعلَّم بعدم الاتساق (القائم) ولا تُحذف.
  • مقترح مرفوض: الشبكة للقراءة فقط.
  • مؤشر مكتبة أُوقف: يبقى في المقترحات القائمة، ولا يظهر للتحديد الجديد.

Data integrity

  • SaveProposalTargetsGrid في معاملة واحدة. الفشل في خلية بسبب عدم الاتساق يرفض الدفعة كلها (لا حفظ جزئي)، مع قائمة الخلايا المخالفة.
  • الاعتماد على القيد الفريد القائم في plan_indicators.

Implementation notes

  • الإنجاز يُعرض عبر achievedValue()/percentAchieved() فقط (قاعدة resultsindicatorstargetsreports.md).
  • الشبكة تُحمَّل بعدد استعلامات ثابت (المقترح + المشاريع + المؤشرات + المستهدفات + إنجاز السنة السابقة).

Testing requirements

  • تحديد مؤشر ينشئ instance بالمكتبة الصحيحة تحت العقدة المختارة.
  • إلغاء تحديد مؤشر له مستهدفات: مرفوض.
  • الشبكة تحفظ لكل مركز، والفراغ لا ينشئ صفًا، والصفر ينشئ.
  • خلية لمشروع غير مرتبط: الدفعة كلها مرفوضة.
  • تزامن: إصدار قديم يُرفض.
  • مستخدم بلا targets.create: عرض فقط و403 عند الحفظ.

Acceptance criteria

  • MEAL يختار المؤشرات ويدخل مستهدفات كل المراكز من شاشة واحدة.
  • صفحة Project تعرض مؤشراته من كل المصادر.

Mistakes to avoid

  • حساب الإنجاز في الشبكة بمعادلة محلية.
  • حفظ جزئي للشبكة.
  • السماح لأي حامل proposals.update بتعديل المستهدفات.

تعديلات المراجعة 2 (2026-10-08)

  • المستهدفات لكل مركز تُدخل في مرحلة المقترح (قبل الاعتماد)، فيصل المقترح إلى المانح بخطته وأرقامه كاملة.
  • «المركز» في الشبكة = المشروع المرتبط بمركز HR (Task 30)، ويُعرض باسم المركز ومدينته.
  • يجب أن تكتمل الشبكة قبل CP3 (اليوم 9)، لأن أسطر التقرير الشهري والتقرير التجميعي (Task 19) تُبنى منها.

تعديلات المراجعة 3 (2026-10-09، من micro logic.xlsx)

  • المستهدف الافتراضي: إذا جاء المؤشر من إطار البرنامج (استيراد Task 32، copied_from_id)، تُعبّأ خلايا الشبكة مسبقًا من indicators.target في إطار البرنامج كاقتراح بلون مختلف، ولا يُحفظ إلا بتأكيد MEAL (مثل إنجاز السنة السابقة، D-11).
  • معاني المستهدف في الإطار المعياري (D-37): قيمة (مثل 80%) تُقترح كما هي؛ «-» = مؤشر رصد بلا مستهدف: يُضاف المؤشر إلى المقترح دون صف في plan_indicators، ويظهر في التقارير قيمةً بلا نسبة إنجاز؛ «**» = يُحدد لكل مشروع، فالخلية فارغة وإلزامية قبل submitted (تحذير لا منع في concept note)؛ «زيادة 20%» = مستهدف من نوع تغيّر عن خط الأساس، ويُدخل كنسبة (percentage) مع indicators.baseline.
  • الشبكة لمؤشرات average: القيمة بلا حد أقصى 100، والوحدة من المكتبة (ل.س، كغ/هكتار…).
  • عمود المسؤول والتواتر: يُعرض بجانب كل مؤشر (collected_by وfrequency) حتى يعرف MEAL أي المؤشرات ستظهر في التقرير الشهري للمركز وأيها يجمعه هو.

تعديلات المراجعة 4 (2026-10-12، سيناريو نموذج التقرير الشهري)

  • مستهدفات المقترح = التزام المانح، ومستهدف التقرير الشهري يضعه MEAL في Task 33. الشبكة هنا تبقى مصدر plan_indicators لكل مانح ومركز، ويقرأها Task 33 كاقتراح عند بناء النموذج. MEAL يحدد المستهدف المعتمد للتقرير (رقم أو نسبة حسب عدد المستفيدين في المقترح) عند تأكيد النموذج، دون أن يُكتب فوق مستهدف المانح.
  • المؤشر نفسه لمانحين بمستهدفين مختلفين: يبقى صفّين في plan_indicators (لكل مانح التزامه)، ويُدمجان في بند واحد في النموذج (D-40).
  • ربط المكتبة شرط للتقرير الشهري: مؤشر المقترح بلا library_indicator_id لا يدخل النموذج. تظهر في الشبكة شارة «غير مرتبط بالمكتبة» عليه.

تعديلات المراجعة 5 (2026-10-12، نمط التمويل المشترك D-46)

  • الشبكة لا تتغير: صف plan_indicators لكل مانح ومركز يبقى هو التزام ذلك المانح، وهو الذي يميّز حصته في التقرير الشهري (Task 17).
  • في مشروع برنامجه split، تعرض الشبكة بجانب المؤشر المكرر بين مانحين مجموع مستهدفاتهم («إجمالي المركز»)، لأن مستهدف البند في النموذج = المجموع لا الأعلى (Task 33). في shared يُعرض الأعلى كما الآن.
  • اختبار: مؤشر بمستهدفين 60 و40 في برنامج split ← «إجمالي المركز» 100. في shared ← 60.

تعديلات المراجعة 6 (2026-10-12، إجابات ورشة القرارات)

  • D-23: إدخال المستهدفات وتعديلها لـ MEAL فقط. GM وManagers ومدير البرنامج يرون الشبكة للقراءة، والأزرار مخفية والسياسة ترفض (403 مختبر).
  • D-10: عمود الرمز إلزامي في الشبكة عند إضافة مؤشر، ورسالة التكرار «هذا الرمز مستعمل لمؤشر آخر في المشروع».

تعديلات المراجعة 8 (2026-10-12، إجابات R6 وملفا Syria Cross وChildren University)

  • المستهدف يبقى إجماليًا (D-50a، الافتراضي): لا مستهدف لكل جنس. الإنجاز يُعرض مفصّلًا بجانب المستهدف الإجمالي، كما في الملفين.

## Role and goal
You are implementing Task 31 of the HC Tracking proposal-lifecycle correction plan. Management's clarification: from the moment a proposal is created it holds its whole plan — logframe and indicators (Task 12/13), **milestones**, and the **main tasks of the Media and Finance teams, assigned by department**. You add milestones and department tasks to the proposal from its first draft (`concept note`), show them on a **Plan** tab, give each department a **Department Tasks** page with no money on it, and when the donor approves (D-28) shift the planned dates to the actual grant period once. Media deliverables (old Task 20) become `tasks.kind = media_deliverable`; there is no `media_deliverables` table and no `media-deliverables.*` permission. You are on Team B: you do not change Phase-1 tables (`proposals`, `projects`, `donor_proposal`, `proposal_status_notes`) or the proposal state machine.

## Scope
### In scope
- Migrations: `milestones.proposal_id` (FK `proposals`, nullable; the plan says `cascadeOnDelete` "for drafts only, via the Action" — propose in plan mode whether the FK cascades or restricts while the delete Action removes children of drafts only), `milestones.project_id` → nullable; `tasks.department_id` (HR id, no FK, indexed), `tasks.kind` (default `general`), `tasks.media_kinds` (JSON), `requested_on`, `delivered_on`, `delivered_link`, `delivered_text`, `accepted_at`, `returned_reason`, `plan_shifted_for` (or a separate shift ledger — propose in plan mode).
- Enums `App\Enums\TaskKind` (`general`, `media_deliverable`, `financial`) and `DeliverableKind` (`video`, `photos`, `file`, `text`) with `HasTranslatedLabel` and `values()`; a delivery state (`requested`, `delivered`, `accepted`, `returned`) — reuse `TaskStatus` only if it fits, otherwise propose an enum.
- Actions in `app/Actions/Proposals/` and `app/Actions/Tasks/`: `SaveProposalMilestone`, `SaveDepartmentTask`, `DeliverDepartmentTask`, `AcceptDepartmentTask`, `ReturnDepartmentTask`, `RebaseProposalPlan`; draft deletion cleanup.
- Listener `RebaseProposalPlanOnActivation` (queued, idempotent) on `ProjectActivated`.
- `TaskPolicy`/`MilestonePolicy` updates; `TaskVisibilityScope` gains "`tasks.department_id` = my current department".
- **Plan** tab on **Proposal** (milestones tree; department tasks grouped Media / Finance / Other; suggested assignee from the department). Gantt of each linked project shows proposal-level milestones (D-34).
- Page **Department Tasks**: `resources/views/pages/department-tasks/⚡index.blade.php`, `Route::livewire('department-tasks', 'pages::department-tasks.index')->name('department-tasks.index')` in the existing `auth` group + sidebar item.
- Alerts: on create (department head and members), due-soon in working days (setting, default 5), overdue; entries in `DeadlineCatalog`.
- Register the plan's event keys in the Task 21 catalog `App\Notifications\EventCatalog`: `department_task.created`, `.due`, `.overdue`, `.delivered`, `.returned` (direct recipients: the department, the assignee, the requester; MEAL + General Management on overdue only, plan section 3 Task 21 table). If the catalog is not merged yet, add the keys in your PR and coordinate with Dev 3 so `EventCatalogCoverageTest` stays green.
- Lang keys in `lang/{en,ar}/` (`tasks.php`, `milestones.php`, `proposals.php`, new `department_tasks.php`, `enums.php`, `navigation.php`, `titles.php`).
### Out of scope
- Logframe/Activities and indicators (Task 12/13); renewal cloning (Task 10 — leave a reusable copy method only if trivial); notification matrix and MEAL/management fan-out (Task 21); full results chain (Task 16); tours (Task 26); encryption mechanism (Task 22).
- Any change to `proposals`/`projects` columns or `ProposalStatus`/`TransitionProposal`.

## Business rules
- Milestones and tasks can be added from `concept note` and edited until `submitted` with plan rights; after `approved` they follow normal execution rights (`milestones.update` / `tasks.update`).
- A department task is assigned to a **department** first (required); the department head or a `tasks.update` holder may set a person (optional; due date within 7 days and no person → alert).
- `media_deliverable`: `requested → delivered` requires `delivered_on` ≤ today and, per `media_kinds`, a file, a link (video is link-only) or text; `delivered → accepted | returned` (reason required); `returned → delivered` again. Tasks of a rejected proposal stop alerting.
- `financial` tasks (e.g. "Donor financial report", "Payment request") are visible to Finance only; titles carry no amounts.
- Milestones are shared at proposal level, not copied per center (D-34); a center-specific milestone carries `project_id` as well. At least one of `proposal_id` / `project_id` is set (checked in the Action).
- Shift on approval: delta = `actual_date_begin − planned_date_begin`; shift planned dates of milestones and tasks by delta, clip to `actual_date_end`, record it. Applied once per approval (key = `proposal_id` + approval timestamp); dates edited by a user after the shift are never shifted again; several `ProjectActivated` events for one proposal shift once.

## Security and authorization
- Adding milestones/tasks to a proposal: `proposals.update` or `milestones.create`/`tasks.create`, plus visibility of the proposal — `Gate::authorize` inside each Action.
- Department visibility: a `tasks.view` holder whose current position (Task 30) is in the task's department, or the assignee, or a proposal-rights holder. Add it to `TaskVisibilityScope::constrain()` carefully and prove with a test that no one else gains visibility; `allows()` must follow the same rule.
- Media team sees proposal name, description, its tasks and milestones only — no money, no general `proposals.view` (D-16). **Department Tasks** never queries budget, agreements, tranches or currency, and links to `proposals.show` only for users who can view it. Skip the queries server-side; `@can` alone is not enough.
- Object-level: load through the parent (`$proposal->milestones()->whereKey($id)`, department tasks via the scoped query); a task id from another proposal or department gets 403/404 with no write.
- Files: `SecureUpload`, 5 MB, `FileType` list, `UploadName`, `StoredFiles` (use Task 22's encrypted write/stream if merged); downloads through an authorized route with `throttle:files`.
- Every public Livewire method that writes authorizes itself (`AuthorizationCoverageTest`); helpers stay `protected` (`BrowserCallableMethodsTest`). Audit via `TracksActivity` / **Activity Log**.

## Validation
Messages in `lang/en` and `lang/ar`:
- Milestone: `name` required, max:255; `plannedStartDate` ≤ `plannedEndDate`; both inside the proposal's planned period — «المرحلة خارج مدة المقترح».
- Task: `title` required, max:255; `departmentId` required and an existing HR department; `kind` Enum(`TaskKind`); `dueDate` after_or_equal `requestedOn` — «الموعد النهائي لا يسبق تاريخ الطلب»; `mediaKinds` array min:1, each Enum(`DeliverableKind`) for media tasks.
- Delivery: `deliveredOn` before_or_equal:today; `deliveredLink` url, max:2048; `deliveredText` max:5000; `files.*` as above; `returnReason` required on return, max:2000.

## Edge cases and concurrency
- Proposal without planned dates: milestones accepted without dates, with «حدّد مدة المقترح لجدولة المراحل».
- Approval shorter than planned: milestones/tasks past the end are clipped and the proposal owner is notified with the list.
- Department removed/renamed in HR: task shows «قسم غير متاح», alerts go to the proposal owner.
- Draft proposal deleted: its milestones and tasks are deleted in the same transaction; after `submitted` deletion stays blocked (existing).
- Double deliver/accept, or two people acting at once: transaction + `lockForUpdate` on the task, re-check the state; the second call writes nothing.
- Duplicate or retried `ProjectActivated`: the listener locks the proposal and checks the shift key; a failing listener never rolls back the approval (queued, retried, `failed_jobs`).

## Data integrity
- Shift runs in one transaction with the proposal row locked; Activity Log entry with actor "system" and the approval reference.
- Migration order: add columns, then make `milestones.project_id` nullable; `down()` refuses (or documents) restoring NOT NULL while proposal-only milestones exist.
- Ledger keys for alerts include `due_date` (alerts.md). All tables/columns `utf8mb4_unicode_ci`, InnoDB DYNAMIC (`DatabaseEncodingTest`).
- Mirror the `kind` default in `Task::$attributes` (strict-mode trap); factories omit default-bearing columns and expose named states (`mediaDeliverable()`, `financial()`, `forProposal()`).

## Implementation guidance
- `declare(strict_types=1);`, `#[Fillable([...])]`, `casts()`, CarbonImmutable, lower-case enum values.
- Extend `tasks` and `milestones`; reuse `x-ui.gantt`, `_list-group`, `x-ui.employee-chip`, the cached employee picker, `x-ui.page-header`, `x-ui.header-filter-select`; Flux modals bound with `wire:model` booleans.
- Working days via `WorkingCalendar`, thresholds via `NotificationSettings`, never calendar days or hard-coded numbers.
- Skeleton:
```php
final class RebaseProposalPlan
{
    /** @return array{shifted: int, clipped: list<int>, skipped: bool} */
    public function handle(Proposal $proposal, CarbonImmutable $actualBegin, CarbonImmutable $actualEnd, string $shiftKey): array {}
}
```
- After merging, update the milestones/tasks rule with Boost `record-rule` (glob `resources/views/pages/{milestones,tasks}/**`: "a milestone may belong to a proposal; `project_id` is nullable").

- `tests/Feature/RebaseProposalPlanTest.php`: shift once by the begin delta; clip to the end; second event or re-run shifts nothing; user-edited dates kept; dispatch the real `ProjectActivated` (when the class exists) and assert one shift.

- Run: `php artisan test --compact tests/Feature/ProposalPlanTest.php`, then `--filter=...` per change.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] From the first draft, a proposal shows its milestones and Media/Finance tasks on **Plan** (logframe from Task 12 when merged).
- [ ] On approval, the plan moves to actual dates once, automatically, and each department sees its tasks on **Department Tasks**.
- [ ] No one outside the department, assignee or proposal-rights holders gains task visibility (test); the page shows no money.
- [ ] Media deliverables work end-to-end (request → deliver → accept/return) with alerts in working days.
- [ ] All listed tests pass; Pint is clean; schema for CP2 (`milestones.proposal_id`, `tasks.department_id/kind`) demonstrated.

## Do not
- Create a new tasks or media-deliverables table, or `media-deliverables.*` permissions.
- Assign department tasks to people by name instead of department.
- Show money to the Media team, or grant `proposals.view` as a shortcut.
- Create or edit `ProjectActivated` or any Phase-1 table/state machine yourself.
- Copy milestones per center, or shift the plan more than once per approval.
- Duplicate the task forms or gantt component.

## Working method
- Start in plan mode: restate the task in 5 bullets, list files you will touch, list open questions (Plan vs existing Tasks tab, delivery-state enum, shift-key storage, event availability); wait for approval.
- Implement in small steps; after each step run the narrowest relevant tests.
- Run `vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent` after PHP changes.
- If you discover a durable rule or trap, record it with the Boost `record-rule` tool (not native memory).
- Do not commit, push, or run destructive commands (`migrate:fresh`, seeders that reset roles, deleting storage) unless the developer asks.
- Never run anything against production (Team B has no production access).
- Stay inside Task 31's scope; note anything else as a follow-up.

## Report back
Your final message must contain: a short summary; files created/changed; migrations (names, up/down); tests run with pass/fail output; decisions assumed (D-16, D-33, D-34, shift key, Plan tab placement); whether the listener is registered or waiting for `ProjectActivated`. Handoff facts: Task 16 reads proposal-level milestones (`milestones.proposal_id`, optional `result_id`) for the full chain; Task 21 needs the department-task event keys you registered and their recipients; Task 12 (B1) needs the final `milestones` column order so its `result_id` migration does not conflict; Task 10 clones milestones and tasks without actual dates, deliveries or files (name the method if you added one); Task 26 needs the **Plan** tab and **Department Tasks** names for tours and the guide.

Objective

تطبيق توضيح الإدارة: «من لحظة إنشاء البروبوزال يتم توضيح جميع ما يخصه من milestones وactivities وoutcomes وoutputs ومؤشراتها، والمهام الرئيسية التي تخص فريق الإعلام وفريق المالية (حسب القسم)». الإطار المنطقي ومؤشراته في Task 12 وTask 13. هذه المهمة تضيف المراحل ومهام الأقسام إلى المقترح من أول مسودة، وتنقلها إلى التنفيذ عند الاعتماد. وتحلّ محل Task 20 (مخرجات الإعلام صارت مهام قسم الإعلام).

Implementation scope

  • المراحل في المقترح: milestones.proposal_id (FK nullable، cascadeOnDelete للمسودات فقط عبر الـ Action)، وmilestones.project_id يصبح nullable لمراحل المقترح. المرحلة تحمل تواريخ مخططة داخل planned_date_begin…planned_date_end للمقترح. يجوز ربطها بنشاط (milestones.result_id، من Task 12).
  • مهام الأقسام: المهام القائمة متعددة المصدر (tasks.source_type/source_id)، فيُضاف المقترح مصدرًا (source_type = 'proposal'). عمود جديد tasks.department_id (HR، بلا FK) وtasks.kind (TaskKind: general, media_deliverable, financial). حقول الإعلام: media_kinds (JSON: video, photos, file, text)، وrequested_on، وdelivered_on، وdelivered_link، وdelivered_text.
  • تبويب Plan في صفحة Proposal (ومسودة الإنشاء): المراحل (شجرة)، ومهام الأقسام مجمّعة حسب القسم (الإعلام، المالية، أخرى)، مع المسؤول المقترح من القسم.
  • عند الاعتماد (مستمع ProjectActivated من Task 08): إزاحة تواريخ المراحل والمهام بفارق actual_date_begin − planned_date_begin، وقصّها داخل actual_date_end، وتسجيل الإزاحة. المراحل تبقى على مستوى المقترح، وتظهر في جانت كل مشروع مرتبط (D-34).
  • مساحة القسم: صفحة Department Tasks (/department-tasks) تعرض لموظف القسم مهام قسمه من كل المقترحات (اسم المقترح نص فقط، بلا مال). وتُستبدل بها صفحة Media Workspace المقترحة سابقًا.
  • التنبيهات: عند الإنشاء (لرئيس القسم ولأعضائه)، وقبل الموعد بعدد أيام عمل من الإعدادات (افتراضيًا 5)، وعند التأخر. تُسجَّل في DeadlineCatalog.

Required deliverables

ترحيلات (milestones.proposal_id، وproject_id nullable، وtasks.department_id/kind/...)، enum TaskKind وDeliverableKind، Actions (SaveProposalMilestone، SaveDepartmentTask، DeliverDepartmentTask، AcceptDepartmentTask، ReturnDepartmentTask، RebaseProposalPlan)، تحديث TaskPolicy/MilestonePolicy، التبويب والصفحة، إدخالات DeadlineCatalog، اختبارات.

Business rules

  • يمكن إضافة المراحل والمهام منذ حالة concept note، وتعديلها حتى submitted. بعد approved تُعدَّل بصلاحيات التنفيذ العادية (milestones.update/tasks.update).
  • مهمة القسم تُسند إلى قسم أولًا (إلزامي)، ثم يحدد رئيس القسم أو حامل tasks.update الشخص (اختياري حتى قبل الموعد بأسبوع، فتنبيه).
  • مهمة media_deliverable: requested → delivered يتطلب delivered_on ≤ اليوم وملفًا أو رابطًا أو نصًا بحسب النوع. delivered → accepted | returned (بسبب). المهام في مقترح مرفوض تتوقف تنبيهاتها.
  • مهمة financial (مثل «تقرير مالي للمانح»، «طلب الدفعة»): تُرى لقسم المالية فقط، وعنوانها بلا مبالغ.
  • الإزاحة عند الاعتماد idempotent: تُطبَّق مرة واحدة لكل اعتماد (مفتاح = proposal_id + approved_at). التواريخ التي عدّلها مستخدم بعد الإزاحة لا تُزاح مرة ثانية.
  • لا تُنسخ المراحل لكل مركز (D-34). المرحلة الخاصة بمركز واحد تحمل project_id إضافةً إلى proposal_id.

Security and permissions

  • إضافة المراحل والمهام للمقترح: proposals.update أو milestones.create/tasks.create، مع رؤية المقترح.
  • رؤية مهام القسم: حامل tasks.view الذي منصبه الحالي (Task 30) في القسم نفسه، أو المسند إليه، أو حامل صلاحية المقترح. يُضاف الشرط إلى TaskVisibilityScope بحذر، مع اختبار لعدم توسيع الرؤية لغيرهم.
  • فريق الإعلام يرى اسم المقترح ووصفه ومهامه ومراحله، بلا مال وبلا proposals.view عامة (D-16).
  • الملفات بقواعد الرفع والتشفير نفسها (SecureUpload، 5MB، Task 22). يُضاف الفيديو برابط (delivered_link) لا بالرفع.

Validation rules

  • المرحلة: name required، وplannedStartDate ≤ plannedEndDate، وداخل فترة المقترح المخططة — «المرحلة خارج مدة المقترح».
  • المهمة: title required، وdepartmentId required وقسم HR موجود، وdueDate ≥ requestedOn — «الموعد النهائي لا يسبق تاريخ الطلب»، وmediaKinds array min:1 للنوع الإعلامي.
  • deliveredLink: url, max:2048، وdeliveredText: max:5000.

Exceptional and edge cases

  • مقترح بلا تواريخ مخططة: تُقبل المراحل بلا تواريخ، ويظهر «حدّد مدة المقترح لجدولة المراحل».
  • اعتماد بتواريخ أقصر من المخططة: المراحل التي تتجاوز النهاية تُقصّ، ويُشعَر مالك المقترح بقائمتها.
  • قسم حُذف أو أُعيدت تسميته في HR: المهمة تعرض «قسم غير متاح»، والتنبيه يذهب لمالك المقترح.
  • مقترح يُستنسخ للتجديد (Task 10): المراحل والمهام تُنسخ بلا تواريخ فعلية ولا تسليمات ولا ملفات.
  • حذف مسودة المقترح: مراحلها ومهامها تُحذف معها، وبعد submitted يُمنع الحذف (القائم).

Data integrity

  • الإزاحة في معاملة واحدة مع قفل المقترح، والتسجيل في Activity Log بالفاعل «النظام» ومرجع الاعتماد.
  • milestones: قيد تحقق في الـ Action أن proposal_id أو project_id موجود (أحدهما على الأقل).
  • مفاتيح ledger للتنبيهات تتضمن due_date (قاعدة alerts.md).

Implementation notes

  • يُعاد استعمال مكونات الجانت والمهام القائمة (x-ui.gantt، _list-group). يمنع تكرار نماذج المهام.
  • قاعدة milestonestasks.md تُحدَّث بـ record-rule (المرحلة قد تتبع المقترح).

Testing requirements

  • إضافة مرحلة ومهمة قسم لمقترح concept note.
  • الاعتماد يزيح التواريخ مرة واحدة، والإعادة لا تزيح ثانية.
  • موظف في قسم الإعلام يرى مهام قسمه، وموظف من قسم آخر بلا صلاحية لا يراها (403/غياب).
  • لا مبالغ في صفحة Department Tasks (فحص HTML).
  • التسليم بلا ملف/رابط/نص مرفوض، والإعادة تتطلب سببًا.
  • التنبيه قبل الموعد بأيام عمل (تجميد الوقت).
  • BOLA: معرّف مهمة من مقترح آخر مرفوض.

Acceptance criteria

  • منذ أول مسودة يعرض المقترح خطته كاملة: الإطار المنطقي (Task 12)، والمراحل، ومهام الإعلام والمالية.
  • عند الاعتماد تتحول الخطة إلى تواريخ فعلية تلقائيًا، ويرى كل قسم مهامه في مساحته.

Mistakes to avoid

  • إنشاء جدول مهام جديد بدل توسيع tasks.
  • إسناد مهام الأقسام لأشخاص بالاسم بدل القسم.
  • إظهار المال لفريق الإعلام.

## Role and goal
You are implementing Task 10 of the HC Tracking proposal-lifecycle correction plan (Laravel 13, PHP 8.5, Livewire 4, Flux UI 2, Pest). You are on Team B (owner B3, reviewed by Dev 2; backend parts also reviewed by Dev 1), days 7–8, 2 days of effort.

The binding domain fact (plan section 1.0, D-30): **a project is a center**. Every project is linked to one HR center (`projects.center_id`), and a center has at most one open project (`draft`/`active`). A new grant for an existing center is **a new proposal on the same project**, never a new project. So "renewal" in this task means:
- **Start from Previous Proposal**: clone last year's proposal (donor, linked projects/centers, notes, logical framework and its indicators from Task 12, milestones and department tasks from Task 31 without actual dates, deliveries or files) into a fresh `concept note`, linked to its predecessor through `proposals.previous_proposal_id`, showing last year's achievement beside each target as a reference only.
- **Duplicate detection** when creating a project: same center with an open project → refused, with a link "Add a proposal to it" (the refusal rule itself is Task 30's; you add the call to action); similar name in another center → a non-blocking **Similar Projects** warning.
- **History**: the chain "previous ← current → next" on the **Proposal** page, and a "Funding history" list (all proposals of the center and their donors across years, no money) on the **Project** page.

There is **no** `projects.previous_project_id` and **no** `CreateRenewalProject` action: older drafts of this prompt had them; they contradict the revised plan and must not be built. Task 13 (target suggestions) and Task 18 (year comparison in **Monthly Matrix**) consume `previous_proposal_id`.

- `App\Actions\Proposals\CloneProposalForRenewal`.
- `App\Support\SimilarProjects` (similarity query, max 5 rows).
- Cycle guard for `previous_proposal_id` (a proposal cannot precede itself or any ancestor): in an observer on `Proposal` (`saving`, only when the column is dirty and non-null) — check whether a `ProposalObserver` exists first; create it otherwise and register it with `#[ObservedBy]`.
- Create Proposal (Task 06 form): **Start from Previous Proposal** — pick a visible previous proposal (approved/completed/rejected), enter the new internal number, open the form pre-filled; save through `CloneProposalForRenewal`.

- Closed project of a center with no open project: offer **Add a proposal to it**; linking the new proposal reopens it as a dateless draft through Task 06's step (D-30). Archived project: offer **Restore** (Task 05 `RestoreProject`, D-27) first, then the same link. Never write `status` directly.

Note anything else as a follow-up.

## Business rules
- No project is created to renew a grant for an existing center. The renewal is a new proposal linked to the same project(s).
- Clone **never** copies: status (always `concept note`, first `ProposalStatusNote` written by `SaveProposal`), actual dates, files, agreement, reports, reviewers, deliveries of department tasks (`delivered_on`, `delivered_link`, `delivered_text`, delivery files), monthly reports, transfers.
- Clone copies: donor, linked projects (centers), notes, planned duration (as planned dates the user may edit), the proposal logical framework and its indicators (Task 12), milestones and department tasks (Task 31) with planned dates only and statuses reset; `previous_proposal_id` points to the source.
- A linked project whose HR center became inactive is skipped and named in the result message. A library indicator that became inactive (Task 11) is skipped and named in the message.
- Targets (`plan_indicators`) are **not** copied as commitments; last year's values are shown as references (D-11), read through `PlanIndicator::achievedValue()` / `percentAchieved()` on the previous proposal's targets matched by library indicator and project.
- The clone needs a new unique `internal_project_number` (existing Task 06 rules, `TEMP-` reserved): the action opens the pre-filled form; it never saves silently.
- Duplicate detection: same center + open project = **refuse** (Task 30 rule, with the link); similar name in another center = **warn only**.
- The clone goes through `SaveProposal`, so `proposal.created` is emitted once (Task 21 catalog); do not emit a second creation event.

## Security and authorization
- `CloneProposalForRenewal`: `Gate::authorize('create', Proposal::class)` (`proposals.create`); `ActionAuthorizationTest` enforces `Gate::authorize(` in `app/Actions`.
- The previous proposal must be visible to the user (`Gate::allows('view', $previous)`), re-loaded and re-checked on the server; ids from the client are never trusted. Linked projects are read from the previous proposal's relation, not from the request.
- Copying the framework also needs `results.create`; copying milestones/department tasks needs `milestones.create` / `tasks.create` (or `proposals.update`, per Task 31). Without them the proposal is cloned without that part and the message says so.
- **Similar Projects** and **Funding history** show names, center, program, donor name and status only — no budget, requested amount, agreement amount or transfers.
- Activity Log (`activities`): the clone records its source id on the new proposal's creation entry (or a dedicated event the Task 21 catalog lists — ask in plan mode).

## Validation
- `previousProposalId`: nullable, integer, exists, visible, status in approved / completed / rejected (map to the Task 04 `ProposalStatus` cases; ask if "approved" should include `active`/`final reports`) — ar «اختر المقترح الذي يتجدد» / en "Choose the proposal being renewed."
- No cycle: a proposal cannot be its own predecessor or a predecessor of any ancestor — messages in `proposals.php`.
- New internal number: the existing Task 06 rules.
- Similar-project confirmation flag: required (accepted) when matches exist — «يوجد مشاريع بأسماء مشابهة؛ أكّد أن هذا مشروع جديد».
- All messages in `lang/ar/*.php` + `lang/en/*.php` of the module; no literal strings.

## Edge cases and concurrency
- Double click on clone: idempotent — key = `previous_proposal_id` + an open `concept note` clone by the same user in the last 2 minutes; return the existing draft. If `proposals` has no creator column, use an atomic `Cache::lock` keyed by user + source and the `proposal.created` activity actor; do not add a column without approval.
- Renewing from a proposal whose project is now closed: the clone links that project and `SaveProposal` reopens it as a dateless draft (Task 06's step), only if the center has no other open project; otherwise the clone links the center's current open project — ask in plan mode which applies when they differ.
- Two users cloning the same source at once: both are allowed (two drafts), the second user sees a notice "a renewal draft already exists: {number}".
- Name typed in Arabic or with diacritics: search uses `utf8mb4_unicode_ci` with `App\Support\Like::contains`.
- Partial failure while cloning framework, milestones or tasks: the whole clone rolls back.
- Previous proposal deleted later: `nullOnDelete` keeps the renewal; the chain shows "removed".

## Data integrity
- Clone runs in one transaction: proposal + project links + first status note + framework rows + indicators + milestones + department tasks; tree parents are remapped to the new ids (copy parents before children, keep an old→new id map), never pointing back into the source.
- Every copied row carries `copied_from_id` where the column exists.
- The cycle guard walks up `previous_proposal_id` one query per level (same approach as `HasTree::wouldCycleUnder`) and throws `InvalidParentException` (add a named constructor). Raw query-builder writes bypass observers (documented trap in `observers.md`).
- Migration: nullable column only, FK as stated, `utf8mb4_unicode_ci` / InnoDB DYNAMIC, working `down()` (drop FK, then column).
- HR data (center, city, employee names) is read through `HrCenter` / `EmployeeProfile`, never copied into tracking tables.

## Implementation guidance
- Similarity: normalise the typed name into words, `where` with `Like::contains` per word, optionally same `program_id`, exclude the current center, limit 5, newest first; computed property fed by `wire:model.live.debounce.400ms`. No new packages.
- Never `whereHas` across the `hr` connection; load center names with one batched lookup.
- Reuse the existing tree/gantt/task components (`x-ui.*`, `_list-group`) for showing copied plans; do not duplicate forms.
- `php artisan make:migration ... --no-interaction`, `make:class` for Support/Actions, `make:observer`.
- Flux modals with `wire:model` booleans, `x-ui.*` components, logical Tailwind classes, all text through `__()`.
- Skeleton:
```php
final class CloneProposalForRenewal
{
    /** @return array{proposal: Proposal, skippedProjects: list<string>, skippedIndicators: list<string>, copied: array{results: int, indicators: int, milestones: int, tasks: int}} */
    public function handle(Proposal $previous, array $data, User $user): array {}
}
```
- After merge, record the durable rule "renewal = new proposal on the same project; no project chain" with Boost `record-rule` (glob `{app/Actions/Proposals/**,resources/views/pages/proposals/**,resources/views/pages/projects/**}`).

## Tests (Pest)
- `tests/Feature/ProposalRenewalCloneTest.php`: clone copies only the allowed fields; status `concept note`; `previous_proposal_id` set; same projects linked; files/agreement/reports/reviewers/deliveries not copied; framework copied with `copied_from_id` and remapped parents when Task 12 exists; milestones/tasks copied with planned dates only when Task 31 exists; without `results.create` cloned without framework + message; inactive library indicator skipped; inactive HR center skipped; double click creates one clone; cycle refused; invisible previous proposal → 403/validation error; user without `proposals.create` → 403 (fresh Livewire instance per forbidden call); last year's achievement equals `achievedValue()`.
- `tests/Feature/ProjectDuplicateDetectionTest.php`: second open project for the same center refused with a link to the existing project; a closed project of the center returns to a dateless draft when a renewal proposal is linked to it (Task 06's step); an archived one is offered **Restore** first; no project chain column exists.
- `tests/Feature/SimilarProjectsTest.php`: a similar-name project in another center appears; max 5; no money in the output; saving requires the confirmation flag; Arabic name matching.
- `projects/⚡show` **Funding history** lists all proposals and donors of the center, with no amounts in the HTML.
- Migration test with id-returning helpers: `nullOnDelete` on `previous_proposal_id`.
- Commands: `php artisan test --compact tests/Feature/ProposalRenewalCloneTest.php`, then `--filter=...` per change.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Renewing a center's grant never creates a project; it creates a `concept note` proposal on the same project(s), linked to its predecessor.
- [ ] A second open project for the same center is refused with a link to "Add a proposal to it"; similar names only warn.
- [ ] The **Project** page shows every proposal of the center and its donor across years; the **Proposal** page shows the previous/next chain.
- [ ] Last year's achievement is shown beside each target of a renewal proposal, read through `PlanIndicator` methods.
- [ ] Existing project and proposal directory/detail tests pass; Pint clean; touched test files green.

## Do not
- Create `projects.previous_project_id`, `CreateRenewalProject`, or any new project as part of a renewal.
- Copy files, agreements, reports, reviewers, statuses, actual dates, deliveries or targets as commitments.
- Block project creation because of name similarity.
- Re-implement the Task 30 open-project refusal, or write `projects.status` outside the Task 05 / Task 06 actions.
- Change other Phase 1 tables (`projects`, `donor_proposal`, `proposal_status_notes`) beyond the one approved column or the state machine (inter-team rule 1).
- Compute achievement with a local formula, add a dependency, or add a base folder.

## Working method
- Start in plan mode: restate the task in 5 bullets, list files you will touch, list open questions (`copied_from_id` on indicators/milestones/tasks, idempotency key, statuses accepted as "previous", closed vs open project when they differ, framework/plan copy if CP2 is not merged); wait for approval.
- Implement in small steps; after each step run the narrowest relevant tests.
- Run `vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent` after PHP changes.
- If you discover a durable rule or trap, record it with the Boost `record-rule` tool (not native memory).
- Do not commit, push, or run destructive commands (`migrate:fresh`, seeders that reset roles, deleting storage) unless the developer asks.
- Never run anything against production; Team B uses seeded or masked data only.
- Stay inside Task 10's scope; note anything else as a follow-up.

Objective

تطبيق «مشروع مكرر أو مشروع جديد ← تجديد مشروع موجود» و«مشروع مكرر (نساعد بالتنبؤ وقت إنشاء البروبوزال)» مع حقيقة أن المشروع هو المركز: التجديد لا يُنشئ مشروعًا جديدًا، بل مقترحًا جديدًا على المشروع (المركز) نفسه، يُعبّأ من مقترح السنة السابقة. وكشف التكرار يمنع إنشاء مشروع ثانٍ مفتوح للمركز نفسه.

Implementation scope

  • proposals.previous_proposal_id (FK إلى proposals، nullOnDelete): سلسلة تاريخ التجديدات.
  • Start from Previous Proposal في Create Proposal: ينسخ المانح والمشاريع (المراكز) والملاحظات، والإطار المنطقي (Task 12) ومؤشرات القائمة، والمراحل ومهام الأقسام بلا تواريخ فعلية (Task 31)، ويعرض إنجاز السنة السابقة بجانب كل مستهدف كمرجع.
  • كشف التكرار عند إنشاء مشروع: المركز نفسه له مشروع مفتوح ← منع مع رابط «أضِف مقترحًا عليه» (قاعدة Task 30). وتشابه الاسم في مركز آخر ← تحذير Similar Projects فقط.
  • سلسلة «السابق ← الحالي» في صفحة Proposal، و«تاريخ التمويل» (كل مقترحات المركز ومانحيها) في صفحة Project.

Required deliverables

ترحيل العمود، App\Actions\Proposals\CloneProposalForRenewal، App\Support\SimilarProjects، تحديث النموذجين والصفحتين، اختبارات.

Business rules

  • لا يُنشأ مشروع جديد لتجديد منحة مركز قائم. المشروع المغلق لمركز يُعاد فتحه كمسودة بلا تواريخ إن لم يكن له مشروع مفتوح، ويُضاف المقترح عليه (D-30).
  • لا يُنسخ عند استنساخ المقترح: الحالة (تبدأ concept note)، والتواريخ الفعلية، والملفات، والاتفاقية، والتقارير، والمعنيون، والتسليمات.
  • المستهدفات لا تُنسخ كقيم ملتزم بها. تُعرض قيم السنة السابقة كمقترحات يؤكدها MEAL (D-11).
  • تشابه الاسم تحذير لا منع. أما المركز والبرنامج نفسهما فمنع (مشروع مفتوح واحد لكل مركز وبرنامج، D-30 المراجعة 6).

Security and permissions

  • الاستنساخ: proposals.create، والمقترح السابق مرئي للمستخدم ويُتحقق في الخادم.
  • استنساخ الإطار المنطقي يتطلب results.create، وإلا يُنسخ المقترح دون الإطار مع رسالة.
  • نتائج Similar Projects تعرض الاسم والمركز والبرنامج فقط، بلا مال.

Validation rules

  • previousProposalId: nullable، موجود، ومرئي، وحالته approved أو completed أو rejected — «اختر المقترح الذي يتجدد».
  • منع الحلقة: المقترح لا يكون سابقًا لنفسه ولا لأحد أسلافه.

Exceptional and edge cases

  • استنساخ متكرر بالنقر المزدوج: الـ Action idempotent بمفتاح (previous_proposal_id + مسودة مفتوحة للمستخدم نفسه في آخر دقيقتين)، وإلا يعرض المسودة الموجودة.
  • مؤشر مكتبة صار غير فعّال: يُتخطى ويُذكر في الرسالة.
  • مركز المقترح السابق صار غير فعّال في HR: يُنسخ المقترح دون ذلك المشروع، مع رسالة.

Data integrity

  • الاستنساخ في معاملة واحدة. كل صف منسوخ يحمل copied_from_id (في results وindicators وmilestones وtasks) للتدقيق.
  • منع الحلقات بأسلوب شجرتي milestones وresults (قاعدة observers.md).

Implementation notes

  • التشابه: LIKE على كلمات الاسم المطبّعة + البرنامج، بحد 5 نتائج، وdebounce 400ms. لا مكتبات جديدة.

Testing requirements

  • محاولة إنشاء مشروع ثانٍ مفتوح للمركز والبرنامج نفسيهما مرفوضة برابط إلى المشروع القائم. البرنامج الآخر في المركز نفسه مسموح.
  • الاستنساخ ينسخ المسموح فقط، والحالة concept note، والمشاريع نفسها مرتبطة.
  • استنساخ بلا results.create: المقترح يُنسخ دون الإطار.
  • النقر المزدوج لا يُنشئ نسختين. الحلقة مرفوضة.

Acceptance criteria

  • صفحة Project تعرض كل مقترحات المركز ومانحيها عبر السنوات.
  • إنجاز السنة السابقة معروض بجانب المستهدف في مقترح التجديد.

Mistakes to avoid

  • إنشاء مشروع جديد لكل منحة.
  • نسخ الملفات أو الاتفاقية أو التقارير أو التسليمات.

## Role and goal
You are implementing Task 14 of the HC Tracking proposal-lifecycle correction plan in this Laravel 13 / Livewire 4 repository. The outcome: whenever a program has no program-level logical framework and work is attached to it, the MEAL team receives one clickable, de-duplicated alert ("add a simple logical framework to achieve the strategy") linking to the results page with the create form open for that program. In the corrected story every proposal's framework contributes to its program's framework (Task 12), so a program without one breaks the chain from strategy to activities; this alert closes that gap early. It also feeds the data-gap markers in Task 16.

## Scope
### In scope
- One alert rule, `program.logframe_missing`, delivered through `AlertDispatcher` with ledger key rule `logframe_missing`, subject `program:{id}`, stage `logframe` (the plan's `program:{id}:logframe`).
- Triggers:
  1. A program newly mirrored from HR without a framework. `Program::syncFromHr()` fires no model events and must stay quiet (`.ai/rules/database-seeders.md`, `QuietWritesTest`). Recommended: make `syncFromHr()` return the newly inserted ids and let `SyncProgramsFromHr` dispatch the check after the sync; seeders keep calling `syncFromHr()` and never notify. Alternative: rely on the daily rule only. Choose in plan mode.
  2. A project created under, or moved to, a program without a framework: create `app/Observers/ProjectObserver.php` (`created`, and `updated` when `program_id` is dirty), attach it with `#[ObservedBy]` next to `MediaOwnerObserver`, and dispatch a queued job `->afterCommit()`.
  3. A daily rule in `DataGapScanner`: "program with open projects and no program framework".
- Create one small notifier (e.g. `app/Notifications/Alerts/LogframeGapAlert.php`) used by all three triggers, so there is one delivery path; and a job (e.g. `app/Jobs/CheckProgramLogframe.php`) for the web-request triggers.
- Re-arm: when the scan finds the program now has a framework, `AlertLedger::release('logframe_missing', 'program', $id)` so a later deletion alerts again.
- Results page deep link: `/results?program={id}&create=1` opens the create modal pre-filled with the program for holders of `results.create` only (follow `indicators/⚡index` `mount()`).
- Event catalog entry `program.logframe_missing` in `App\Notifications\EventCatalog` (Task 21) with MEAL + General Management (digest).
- Lang keys under `notifications.alerts.logframe_missing.*` in `lang/en/notifications.php` and `lang/ar/notifications.php` (single and grouped sentence).
### Out of scope
Framework editing and proposal frameworks (Task 12); chain view gap markers (Task 16); **Default Proposal Reviewers** UI (Task 07); new permissions (Task 02); monthly digest (Task 21).

## Business rules
- "No framework" = no `results` row with `program_id = program` and `proposal_id IS NULL`.
- One alert per program each time the gap is detected; the ledger prevents repeats; it re-arms after a framework appears and is later deleted.
- Not sent while seeding, during the silent HR sync itself, or during imports (`Activity::withoutRecording` contexts).
- Priority `NotificationPriority::Important`.
- Recipients: users with role `MEAL`, plus the MEAL Manager slot of **Default Proposal Reviewers** when present (Task 07). A program without a manager changes nothing.
- Ten programs appearing in one sync produce one grouped notification per recipient stating the count, linking to `/results`; each program still claims its own ledger row.
- Day logic and thresholds follow `.ai/rules/alerts.md`: the daily rule skips non-working days (`WorkingCalendar`), no literal day counts.

## Security and authorization
- Only users holding `results.view` receive it: build the payload with module `results` so `RecipientFilter` applies `results.view` (or document how the check is applied if you keep module `programs`).
- Do not add MEAL-specific logic to `RecipientResolver`; keep recipient knowledge in the notifier, as `DataGapScanner` does, or in the module map.
- No sensitive data: program name and link only, no money, no project lists.
- The deep link opens the create modal only after `Gate::allows('results.create')`; the route stays behind `can:results.view`.

## Validation
No user input. The deep-link `program` and `create` query values are validated: `program` must be an existing program id, `create` must equal `1`; anything else is ignored silently.

## Edge cases and concurrency
- Framework created then deleted: the next daily scan releases/re-claims and alerts again.
- Overlapping scanner runs: `AlertLedger::claim()` is atomic (unique key); `notifications:scan` already runs `withoutOverlapping()`.
- Project created inside a transaction that rolls back: the job is dispatched `afterCommit`, so nothing is sent.
- Program removed from HR: its mirror is kept; it is still checked if it has open projects.
- MEAL user without an HR account or inactive: `RecipientFilter`/`EmployeeRecipients` behaviour applies; no crash.
- Program with only a proposal framework (`proposal_id` not null): still "no framework".

## Data integrity
- Never notify inside a transaction: jobs `->afterCommit()`, observers handle events after commit.
- Ledger rows in `notification_alert_ledger` are the only de-duplication state; no new table.
- `syncFromHr()` keeps `insertOrIgnore` and `Activity::withoutRecording`; changing its return type must keep `ProgramSyncTest` and `QuietWritesTest` green.

## Implementation guidance
- `declare(strict_types=1);`, typed signatures, PHPDoc array shapes, `final` like the other alert classes.
- Query for the gap in one statement (programs left-joined / `whereDoesntHave` on program-level results), not one query per program.
- Payload via `AlertDispatcher::payload('results', NotificationPriority::Important, 'notifications.alerts.logframe_missing.single', ['subject' => $program->name], 'program', $program->id)`, then `send('logframe_missing', 'logframe', ...)`. For the grouped case use a payload `link` to `results.index`.
- If you register a new module in `config/notifications.php`, `DesktopAppTest` requires a `module_icons` entry and rendered banners (`php artisan notifications:banners`); prefer reusing `results`.
- Skeleton:
```php
final class LogframeGapAlert
{
    /** @param list<int> $programIds  @return int notifications sent */
    public function notify(array $programIds): int {}
}
```

Create fixtures inside `Activity::withoutRecording` (`.ai/rules/recipients.md`); use `userWithRole('MEAL')`; assert on the records you created, not on "nothing else exists" (`.ai/rules/alerts.md`).
- `tests/Feature/Notifications/LogframeGapAlertTest.php`:
  - a project created under a program without a framework alerts MEAL once (after commit);
  - a project under a program with a framework does not alert;
  - moving a project to a program without a framework alerts;
  - the daily scan does not repeat an alert already in the ledger;
  - the scan re-arms after a framework is created and later deleted;
  - a user without `results.view` receives nothing;

  - nothing is sent on a non-working day, during seeding, or from `Program::syncFromHr()` called directly;
  - the notification links to `/results?program={id}&create=1`;

## Business rules
- One responsible per city (D-12). Assigning a different employee replaces the previous one.
- Every change is recorded in the **Activity Log** (`activities`) and notifies both the new and the previous responsible.
- `responsibleFor($project)` returns the coverage's `employee_id` for the city of the project's HR center (fallback `$project->city_id` when `center_id` is null) only when that HR employee is active; otherwise `null` and the caller falls back to users with the MEAL role.
- Re-assigning the same employee is a no-op: no write, no activity, no notification.
- A city inactive in HR can still be assigned, with a warning.

## Security and authorization
- Assign/change: `meal-coverage.manage`, checked with `Gate::authorize` inside `AssignMealCoverage`. View: `cities.view` (the existing route gate).
- `employeeId` is verified against HR on the server and must be active; the client picker list (which includes inactive people) is never trusted.
- `cityId` must exist in HR cities; never write to the `hr` connection (`HrModel::save()` throws).
- `assigned_by` comes from `auth()->id()`, never from the request; `#[Fillable]` keeps mass assignment narrow.
- Notifications carry names only, no other HR personal data (`HrEmployee` hides personal fields).

## Validation
Messages in `lang/en/cities.php` and `lang/ar/cities.php`.
- `employeeId`: required, integer, an active HR employee — "اختر موظفًا فعّالًا" / "Choose an active employee". Implement as a closure rule querying `HrEmployee::query()->whereKey($id)->where('is_active', true)->exists()` (no cross-connection `exists:` rule).
- `cityId`: required, integer, an existing HR city — "المدينة غير موجودة" / "City not found".

## Edge cases and concurrency
- Employee left HR (inactive): the row stays; the page shows "Responsible inactive"; `responsibleFor()` returns `null` so the fallback applies.
- Two managers assigning the same city at once: the transaction locks the existing row (`lockForUpdate`); a create race hits the unique index — catch `UniqueConstraintViolationException`, re-read and update, or return a friendly "changed by someone else, reload".
- Permission revoked mid-session: the Action returns 403.
- City deleted from HR: the row stays harmless; the page lists HR cities only.

## Data integrity
- Unique index on `city_id`; assignment in one `DB::transaction` (lock, then create or update through Eloquent so `RecordsActivity` fires — never `DB::table()->upsert()`).
- No FK to HR tables (`.ai/rules/models.md`); FK only on `assigned_by`.
- Migration: `utf8mb4_unicode_ci` / InnoDB DYNAMIC (`DatabaseEncodingTest`), working `down()`.
- Seeding (optional, confirm): one coverage in `database/seeders/MealSeeder.php` using active HR employees only, under `Activity::withoutRecording`; add the model to the list in `tests/Feature/DatabaseSeederTest.php` if seeded.

## Implementation guidance
- `php artisan make:migration create_meal_coverages_table --no-interaction`, `php artisan make:model MealCoverage --factory --no-interaction`, `php artisan make:class Support/MealCoverage --no-interaction` (then adjust namespace/strict types).
- `declare(strict_types=1);` everywhere; `CarbonImmutable` docblocks; Action is a plain class with `handle(?MealCoverage $existing, int $cityId, int $employeeId): MealCoverage` or similar, input validated by the component.
- Cities page: load all coverages in one query keyed by `city_id` and their employees in one HR query (`select([...HrEmployee::NameColumns, 'is_active'])->whereKey($ids)`); no query per card.
- Picker: reuse `x-ui.form-select` in `employees` mode (cached list). Modal: Flux bound with `wire:model` to a boolean. Warnings use `text-status-*` tokens plus an icon, not colour alone.
- Skeleton:
```php
final class MealCoverage
{
    /** The active MEAL employee responsible for the project's city, or null for the MEAL-role fallback. */
    public static function responsibleFor(Project $project): ?int {}
}
```

Objective

تطبيق «مدير MEAL يحدد الـ MEAL المسؤول عن المحافظة» و«MEAL لكل مركز بمسؤول»: كل مدينة (محافظة) لها موظف MEAL مسؤول يتلقى التقارير الشهرية لمراكزها ويتحقق منها.

Implementation scope

  • جدول meal_coverages: city_id (HR، بلا FK)، employee_id (HR، بلا FK)، assigned_by (FK users)، timestamps، فهرس فريد على city_id.
  • قسم في صفحة Cities (/admin/cities): عمود «مسؤول MEAL» مع تعديل لحامل meal-coverage.manage.
  • App\Support\MealCoverage::responsibleFor(Project $project): ?int.

Required deliverables

ترحيل، نموذج، مصنع، Action AssignMealCoverage، تحديث صفحة Cities، اختبارات.

Business rules

  • مسؤول واحد لكل مدينة (D-12). التغيير يُسجَّل في Activity Log (activities) ويُشعَر المسؤول الجديد والسابق.

## Role and goal
You are implementing Task 16 of the HC Tracking proposal-lifecycle correction plan in this Laravel 13 / Livewire 4 / Flux UI 2 repository. The outcome: one read-only tree that shows, for a proposal, a program and an annual plan, the chain Impact -> Outcome -> Output -> Activity, with each node's indicators (library name and code), the target per center with its achievement, and each activity's milestones with status, weighted progress and planned/actual dates — plus gap markers and filters (indicator, center, donor). In the corrected story the proposal's framework contributes to its program's framework "to achieve the strategy" and its activities are delivered through project milestones; this view lets MEAL, the fundraising manager and UAT (Task 28) read the whole line in one screen.

## Revision 2 changes (2026-10-08)
- Owner is now **B3 (Team B)**, reviewed by Dev 2; days 9–10 (Thu 2026-10-22 → Fri 2026-10-23); effort cut from 3 to **2 days**. Dependencies now include **Task 31**.
- The chain now includes the proposal's own plan (Task 31): proposal-level milestones (`milestones.proposal_id`, shared across the proposal's centers, D-34; a center-specific one also carries `project_id`) under their activities, and a per-proposal summary of department tasks (media, finance) — titles, department, status and due date only, never money, and finance-kind tasks only for viewers who may see them (follow Task 31's `TaskVisibilityScope`).
- **First to be cut (R9, item 1):** if the plan is late at CP3 (end of day 9), ship a tree without milestones/department tasks (levels, indicators, per-center targets and achievement only). Structure the work so that cut is a clean stopping point: build the tree first, milestones second.
- Task 24 (annual plan activities) is out of the October window: keep the annual-plan fallback, do not plan a hand-off for it.
- Work under the inter-team rules (plan section 0 «قواعد العمل بين الفريقين»): do not change Phase 1 tables (`proposals`, `projects`, `donor_proposal`, `proposal_status_notes`) or the proposal state machine — request any such change from Dev 1 so it is recorded in the plan; integrate with Phase 1 by listening to its events (`ProposalStatusChanged`, `ProjectActivated`, `ProjectPeriodChanged`, `FundingAgreementRecorded`, dispatched after commit) instead of calling Phase 1 Actions directly; every PR is reviewed by Dev 2 (UI) or Dev 1 (backend) within one working day and merges only with this task's suite green; no production access — seed or masked data only.
- `proposals/⚡show` and `programs/⚡show` are shared pages: keep changes inside the tab/component and coordinate with Dev 2 (proposal pages). This task is read-only and emits no new events.

## Scope
### In scope
- Extend `x-ui.logframe` (and its node/branch partials) to render per node: statement and level mark; indicators (library name in the user's locale with the other language as a secondary line, code LTR-isolated); per-center target and achievement; for activities, their milestones with status badge, weighted progress, planned and actual dates; gap markers.
- Make the component's heading id and title configurable (today it is hard-wired to `programs.results_logframe` / `program-results-heading`).
- Host pages:
  1. `proposals/⚡show` **Logical Framework** tab: the proposal's framework.
  2. `programs/⚡show`: the program framework plus proposal contributions shown under the result each proposal root contributes to (`contributes_to_result_id`), naming proposal and donor as plain text.
  3. `annual-plans/⚡show`: the plan's targets and the year's activities (see precondition).
- Filters (`#[Url]`): indicator, center (project), donor; values restricted to what the page loaded.
- Gap markers: result without indicators, indicator without target, activity without milestone, milestone (of the proposal or its projects) without activity.
- Proposal plan (Task 31): proposal-level milestones under their activities, and a department-tasks summary per proposal (no money; finance tasks only for viewers allowed by `TaskVisibilityScope`). Built after the core tree so it can be dropped under R9.
- A shared tree builder is acceptable (e.g. a class in `app/Support/`) so the three pages build identical node arrays; components render no queries.
- Empty state with a **Start Logical Framework** button for `results.create` holders.
- Lang keys in `lang/en/results_framework.php` + `lang/ar/results_framework.php` (and page groups as needed; never a group named `results`).
### Out of scope
Editing the framework, linking milestones (Task 12); entering targets (Task 13); monthly reports (Task 17); **Monthly Matrix** (Task 18); annual plan activities table and approval (Task 24); tours (Task 26).

## Business rules
- Achievement counts approved reports only, via `PlanIndicator::achievedValue()` / `percentAchieved()` (one definition).
- Weighted milestone progress uses the existing formula: reached weight over the weight of non-cancelled milestones; cancelled milestones count on neither side.
- Proposal contributions appear under the program result they contribute to, with proposal name and donor name as text.
- A multi-program proposal (D-24) appears under each program it contributes to.
- A node whose parent is hidden by a filter is promoted to a display root and shows the hidden lineage as context (existing results-page behaviour).
- Percentages are never summed across centers or donors (D-25); totals show per target.

## Security and authorization
- The view follows the host page's permission (`proposals.view` or Task 07 reviewer access, `programs.view`, `annual-plans.view`). Add no new route.
- Proposal and donor names are plain text; links to `proposals.show` / `donors.show` render only for holders of `proposals.view` / `donors.view` (`.ai/rules/pages.md`).
- No money anywhere in this view: do not load agreements, budgets or transfers.
- Filter values from the query string are validated against the loaded sets (`Rule::in`), never used raw in queries.

## Validation
No user input beyond filters. Unknown filter values are ignored and reset to "All"; nothing is persisted.

## Edge cases and concurrency
- Empty framework: empty state plus **Start Logical Framework** for MEAL (`results.create`); viewers without it see the empty state only.
- Activity with milestones from several projects: group milestones by project (center) under the activity.
- Milestone linked to an activity that no longer fits (Task 12 flags it "outside the framework"): show it with the flag, never hide it.
- Indicator scoped to a project that left the proposal: show the existing chain-issue flag.
- Inactive library entry: still displayed on existing frameworks.
- Read-only view: no concurrency writes; after Task 12/13 writes on the same page, call the page's `forget…()` helper so figures refresh.

## Data integrity
Read only. No migrations, no writes, no observers.

## Implementation guidance
- Load once per page, then filter and shape in PHP (`.ai/rules/results.md`, `.ai/rules/indicators.md`): results of the scope, indicators with library entries, plan indicators with `reports` and `indicator`, projects, milestones with `result_id`, proposals/donor names for contributions. Target a flat query count independent of node count.
- Lineage through eager-loaded `parentRecursive` or the in-memory parent map; never `HasTree::ancestors()` per node.
- Components take prebuilt arrays or models with every relation set (`setRelation`); no lazy loading (strict mode throws).
- Keep the shared ResultType mark/accent mapping (`.ai/rules/components-ui.md`) and keep `data-tree-depth` / `data-result-type` attributes.
- RTL/LTR: logical spacing (`ms-*`, `ps-*`, `pe-*`, `start-*`), directional icons `rtl:rotate-180`, numbers `tabular-nums`, mixed names `dir="auto"`.
- Flux components and `x-ui.*` (`x-ui.panel`, `x-ui.empty-state`, `x-ui.enum-badge`, `x-ui.progress-bar`, `x-ui.header-filter-select`). No `@php(...)` shorthand; Graphite tokens behind `dark:`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] From the **Proposal** page one screen reads Impact -> ... -> Activity -> Milestone with achievement per center, including the proposal's own milestones and department tasks (Task 31) — or, if cut under R9, the tree without milestones.
- [ ] The program page shows proposal contributions under the right results; the annual plan page shows its targets and the year's activities.

Objective

تطبيق «we should see everything from Impact → Activities» و«Annual Plan → indicators and activities to achieve · milestones to reach»: عرض شجري واحد يُظهر لكل مقترح (ولكل برنامج ولكل خطة سنوية) الأثر ← النتائج ← المُخرَجات ← الأنشطة، مع المؤشرات والمستهدفات لكل مركز والإنجاز والمراحل المرتبطة وتقدمها.

Implementation scope

  • توسيع مكوّن x-ui.logframe ليعرض: العقدة، ومؤشراتها (اسم المكتبة، الرمز)، والمستهدف لكل مركز والإنجاز (achievedValue)، والأنشطة ومراحلها (الحالة، التقدم الموزون، التواريخ المخططة/الفعلية).

  • مرشحات: المؤشر، المركز، المانح.
  • علامات الفجوة: نتيجة بلا مؤشرات، مؤشر بلا مستهدف، نشاط بلا مرحلة، مرحلة بلا نشاط.

  • إسهامات المقترحات في إطار البرنامج تُعرض تحت النتيجة التي تسهم فيها، مع اسم المقترح والمانح كنص.

Security and permissions

  • لا مبالغ في هذا العرض.

Validation rules

لا إدخال (عرض فقط، والمرشحات مقيدة بقيم معروفة).

## Role and goal
You are implementing Task 32 of the HC Tracking proposal-lifecycle correction plan in this Laravel 13 / PHP 8.5 / Livewire 4 / Flux UI 2 repository. The outcome:
1. The 2026–2030 strategy is split into its three **strategic pillars** (economic empowerment & family support; youth & student empowerment; childhood development & positive parenting), and every program can be assigned to one pillar.
2. The real **Micro** program logical framework (two tracks: urban, and agricultural/livestock; 37 indicators) is imported into the Indicator Library and the program's Results Framework from committed JSON data files.
3. A reusable `App\Actions\Results\CopyResultTree` copies a program framework root into a proposal, driven by a **Start from Program Framework** button on the proposal's **Logical Framework** tab. Task 10 reuses it for renewals.

Strategic objectives, yearly strategic targets and the strategy scorecard are **Task 32b, out of the October window** — do not build them.
