## Scope
### In scope
- **Automated gates.** These run locally or in CI, never on production:
  - `php artisan test --compact` (the developer runs it, per CLAUDE.md; you run it only when asked);
  - `vendor/bin/phpstan analyse` (level 7, no baseline). Classify each error as new (its file changed since the plan baseline `0a21efc5`) or pre-existing;
  - `vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent`.
- **DoD test-gap audit.** Produce a matrix of new Action / page / command / model → test. It must show:
  - a success, validation, 403 and BOLA test for every new Action that takes a child id;
  - a constant query-count test for **Logical Framework**, **Indicator Library**, **Monthly Matrix** and the targets grid;
  - idempotency and `--dry-run` tests for each new command;
  - a TracksActivity test for each new model;
  - Task 04's arch test forbidding direct `status` writes on `Proposal`;
  - idempotency tests for the event listeners (monthly report generation on `ProjectActivated` / `ProjectPeriodChanged`, transfer generation, Task 31 plan rebase) and `EventCatalogCoverageTest` (Task 21);
  - localized messages for every validation rule.

  Also review every entry added to `authorizationCoverageExemptions()` since the baseline, and check that new money helpers are covered by `BrowserCallableMethodsTest`.
- **Closing gaps.** With approval, you may add tests only, to close DoD gaps. One example: an end-to-end journey test, `tests/Feature/ProposalLifecycleJourneyTest.php`, if no CP4 end-to-end integration test exists (search first). Never change `app/`, `resources/`, `config/`, `database/`, `routes/` or `lang/`.
- **Documents** in `docs/superpowers/specs/` (confirm the names in plan mode):
  - `2026-10-27-proposal-lifecycle-uat-scripts.md`;
  - `2026-10-27-proposal-lifecycle-qa-report.md`. It contains the gate outputs, the DoD matrix, the checklists, the defect log, a read-only data-integrity SQL appendix and the Go/No-Go summary.
- **UAT scripts.** Each persona gets preconditions (role, data, settings), numbered steps with the expected result, negative steps, money checks, an Arabic UI check, the evidence to capture, Pass/Fail and a defect id. The default roles below must be confirmed against the signed matrix:
  1. **Projects & Fundraising Manager** (default `Public Relations Manager`, with a `Financial` user for the budget and agreement steps):
     - create a draft project by picking an HR center (city derived, no date fields), the **Similar Projects** warning, and a renewal as a new proposal on the same project;
     - **New Concept Note** with donor and project, plus the skip-with-reason path; add its plan (**Plan** tab: milestones and media/finance department tasks) from the concept note stage;
     - concept note review: reviewers are invited, then submitted, with the warning listing reviewers who have not seen it (D-15);
     - proposal draft → Finance enters `requested_budget` → proposal review → submitted;
     - `on hold` with a reminder date; a reject with a reason of at least 10 characters;
     - **Approve Proposal** with the dates; the linked projects become active, or wait for the owner; the monthly reports are generated for every month of the period and the plan's milestones and tasks shift to the actual dates;
     - **Change Status** offers only the allowed transitions.
  2. **MEAL** (`MEAL`, configured as the MEAL Manager slot in **Default Proposal Reviewers** and as the MEAL owner of the test city):
     - **Indicator Library**: unique code, measure lock, deactivate;
     - **Logical Framework**: four levels, and the root contributes to a program result;
     - **Indicators & Targets**: the per-centre grid filled before approval (empty vs 0; percentage ≤ 100; the whole batch is refused on any bad cell; columns show the HR center and city);
     - the logframe-missing alert;
     - validate or return a monthly report, without editing it, and never one they prepared (four eyes);
     - the reopen decision;
     - **Monthly Matrix**: filters, aggregation, CSV;
     - the full chain view.
  3. **Finance** (`Financial`):
     - **Record Agreement** only for an approved proposal; the donor is read-only; a second agreement is refused;
     - recording the agreement generates one expected transfer record (`transfers_tracking`); Finance completes the received amount, `fees` and exchange rate (D-31); recording twice creates no second record;
     - the finance section of an aggregated donor report is visible to Finance only.
  4. **Centre manager** (the project owner, holding `reports.create/update`, e.g. `Managers`):
     - acknowledge the owner assignment, after which the project activates;
     - **Monthly Reports**: every month of the project period is already generated; months that have not started are "upcoming", never overdue;
     - **Monthly Report**: values (0 allowed), notes and files; submit refused before the month's last working day and while the previous month is unsubmitted (sequencing on submit);
     - submit, after which editing is refused;
     - **Request Reopen** with a reason;
     - **My Reporting Duties** and the **My Team** card, if applicable.
  5. **Media and Finance departments** (staff whose current HR position is in the department; `Public Relations Manager` as requester):
     - a department task in the proposal's plan (**Plan** tab) reaches the department on creation and in **Department Tasks**;
     - the reminder before the due date (working days; UI and settings only on staging);
     - deliver a media task with a file, a link (video) or a text; accept, or return with a reason;
     - a finance task is visible to the finance department only; a member of another department does not see it;
     - the proposal shows as name and description only, no money.
  6. **Aggregated donor report** (Projects & Fundraising Manager, `reports.aggregate`):
     - in the **Donor Report Builder**, pick a proposal with several centers and a quarterly, then a semi-annual period;
     - only validated monthly figures count; the completeness section lists unsent or unvalidated months; percentages are not summed across centers;
     - **Save as Donor Report** freezes a snapshot; **Mark as Submitted** requires the final file; a submitted report cannot be regenerated;
     - a responsible without money permissions sees it in **My Reporting Duties** without amounts.
  7. **MEAL and General Management oversight**:
     - every movement in scenarios 1–6 (project, proposal, monthly report, donor report, department task) reaches MEAL and General Management, immediately or in the daily digest per the **Event Notifications** settings;
     - a person who is both a direct and an oversight recipient gets one notification; the actor is not notified of their own action; activation sends one grouped `monthly_reports.generated` notification, not one per month.
  8. **Project = center**:
     - a second open project for the same HR center is refused with the message pointing to the existing project;
     - renewal is a new proposal on the same project; linking it to a closed project returns that project to a dateless draft; a closed or archived project does not count as open, so it never blocks the center;
     - an inactive HR center shows its badge and cannot be picked for a new project.
  9. **No-money user** (`Public Relations Manager`, `MEAL`, `Managers`, `Media Team`): walk every screen of 1–8 and confirm no amount appears in pages, modals, the activity timeline, notifications, emails (monthly digest), CSV exports, **My Reporting Duties**, **Department Tasks**, the **Donor Report Builder** (no finance section), **Similar Projects** or the logframe. Proposal, donor and agreement links render only with that page's view permission.

  Add short scripts for:
  - a reviewer without `proposals.view` (sees the page, but no money);
  - Super Admin **Correct Status** (required reason, marked as a correction), and the same action refused for General Manager;
  - General Manager **Supervision** (HR direct managers shown read-only, local exceptions added);
  - the monthly digest triggered on staging with `php artisan reports:monthly-digest` (the developer runs it).
- **Concurrency scripts (two windows):**
  - approve the same proposal (the second gets "already approved");
  - submit a monthly report while a line is edited ("submitted and locked");
  - record two agreements for one proposal (one agreement, one transfer record);
  - save the targets grid twice (the stale row is refused);
  - double-click **Mark as Seen**;
  - a stale **Change Status** dialog.
- **Manual penetration checklist** (staging only):
  - Tamper with ids in Livewire calls using `$wire` in the devtools console: another reviewer's record, a line from another monthly report, a grid cell outside the proposal's projects or logframe, another proposal's donor report snapshot, another department's task, an unapproved proposal or a forged donor in **Record Agreement**, `startDate` on a draft project, a disallowed or `approved` status, `requested_budget` from a no-money user, a previous project the user cannot see.
  - Swap the file id across records on every download and preview route, old and new.
  - Open slugs of out-of-scope records.
- **Accessibility and RTL checklist:**
  - keyboard navigation in the targets grid, the **Monthly Report** grid and **Monthly Matrix**;
  - `aria-label` on icon buttons and grid inputs;
  - contrast in light and dark;
  - status never shown by colour alone;
  - Arabic and English layouts, and 375px width;
  - every validation message appears in Arabic at its field. Take the messages from `lang/ar`.

### Out of scope
- Fixing defects in application code (the owning task, in a new session).
- Rehearsal (Task 27) and deployment (Task 29).
- Changing the permission matrix or the plan.
- Any production access.

## Business rules
- No deployment while a defect of severity Critical or High is open. Define the severities in the report:
  - Critical: data loss or corruption, money exposure, auth bypass, the core path blocked;
  - High: a story step fails for a role, or a server rule is missing;
  - Medium: a workaround exists or the UI is wrong;
  - Low: cosmetic.
- Go requires all of the following: the full suite is 100% green, PHPStan shows no new errors, Pint is clean, 0 Critical/High defects are open, and MEAL, Funding and Finance representatives have signed UAT. You cannot sign for anyone.
- A scenario is Pass only with tester evidence. Each scenario is run with the persona's role, never with Super Admin.

## Security and authorization
- Testers use their own HR accounts. You never type, store or request passwords or 2FA codes.
- Documents contain record slugs or ids only: no personal data and no amounts. Screenshot evidence lives outside the repository, in storage the testers choose.
- Penetration tests run on staging only, and their findings go to the defect log, not to chat or tickets that non-finance staff can read.
- Check permissions by exact name: `proposals.manage-reviewers`, `proposals.correct-status` (Super Admin only), `reports.approve`, `reports.reopen`, `indicator-library.*`, `reports.aggregate`, `tasks.*` for department tasks (no `media-deliverables.*` exists), `meal-coverage.manage`, `supervisions.manage`, `funding-agreements.create/update`, `targets.create/update`.

## Validation
- Each new form gets negative steps that trigger each server rule and check the Arabic message at its field. Examples: donor required, at least one project, the reason of at least 10 characters, a reminder date in the future, grant end ≥ start, donor report period inside the grant, milestone inside the proposal period, task due date not before its request date, submitted-on ≤ today, a center required on a new project, a period that is not in the future, a value ≥ 0 and ≤ 100 for percentages, a unique library code.

## Edge cases and concurrency
- A tester's role was edited by an admin in the UI. `permissions:sync` adds and never removes, so record each tester's actual permissions next to the matrix.
- Department-scoped task visibility applies to `task_department_scoped_roles`.
- An inactive HR employee as a reviewer, assignee or MEAL owner shows "inactive" and is not notified.
- Alerts based on working days cannot be time-travelled on staging. UAT checks the UI and the settings; the frozen-time Pest tests prove the timing. List those tests in the DoD matrix.
- On staging, email goes to the log or the test mailbox; the queue worker must run for notifications.

## Data integrity
- Write a read-only SQL appendix to run on the staging DB before and after UAT:
  - orphan checks: `media` rows whose polymorphic owner is missing (no FK exists); `plan_indicators` with a dangling source (known; see `.ai/rules/database-migrations.md`);
  - unique pairs that must hold: one agreement per proposal, one generated transfer record per agreement, `(project_id, period)` on `monthly_reports`, and at most one open project per `center_id`;
  - per-table counts.
- `php artisan files:prune --dry-run` on staging lists orphaned files without deleting anything.
- Staging data:
  - Option (a) is a fresh `migrate:fresh --seed` on a staging-only database. This is destructive; the developer runs it, and never on the rehearsal copy or on any database with real role edits, because `DatabaseSeeder` runs `RolesAndPermissionsSeeder`.
  - Option (b) is the Task 27 copy with no seeding (real data; management decides on privacy).
  - The plan names `DemoDeliverySeeder` as the new-path seed. Check whether it now creates new-path data (project centers, proposal donor, reviewers, logframe, proposal milestones and department tasks, generated monthly reports, transfer records). If not, record it as a gap; do not write a seeder without approval.

## Implementation guidance
- Write the UAT scripts in Arabic for staff testers. Name each UI element by its Arabic label from `lang/ar/*.php` followed by the English name in bold, e.g. «التقرير الشهري» (**Monthly Report**). Never invent labels.
- IDs:
  - scenarios: `UAT-P1-01`…;
  - concurrency: `UAT-CC-01`;
  - penetration: `PEN-01`;
  - accessibility: `A11Y-01`;
  - defects: `DEF-001`, each with severity, owning task, steps, expected/actual, status and fix reference.
- The QA report is in Arabic like the plan. Commands, test names and code identifiers stay in English. Paste the gate outputs as summaries: counts and failing test names.
- The sign-off sheet has lines for the MEAL, Funding and Finance representatives: role, date, result, signature. No names until they sign.

## Tests (Pest)
- Gate commands: `php artisan test --compact`, `vendor/bin/phpstan analyse`, `vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent`.
- Write only the approved gap-closing tests, in the existing style:
  - `userWithRole()`;
  - a fresh `Livewire::actingAs(...)->test(...)` for each forbidden call;
  - `insertX()` helpers that return ids, read back with `DB::table()`;
  - `DB::listen` for query counts.
- Run each new file with `php artisan test --compact tests/Feature/<File>.php`. A test that fails because the application is wrong stays and is logged as a defect: mark it with `->todo()` only if the developer asks, and never weaken an assertion to make it pass.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The gate results are recorded: the full suite passes 100% (or the failures are logged as defects), PHPStan shows no new errors, Pint is clean.
- [ ] The DoD matrix covers every new Action, page, command and model, and every gap is either closed by a test or logged.
- [ ] The UAT scripts cover scenarios 1–5 and the new 6–9 (aggregated donor report, MEAL and management oversight, project = center, no-money user) plus the reviewer, Super Admin, General Manager and digest scripts, with negative and money checks in each.
- [ ] Go/No-Go evidence is ready by the end of day 13 (CP6).
- [ ] The concurrency, penetration, accessibility/RTL and data-integrity checklists exist and are executable by non-developers.
- [ ] The defect log and severity rules exist, and the Go/No-Go summary lists the open Critical/High defects (target 0) and the signature status.

## Do not
- Test only the happy path, or test only with Super Admin.
- Fix application code, relax a test, or add an exemption to make a gate pass.
- Run anything on production, run seeders on a database with real role edits, or run `migrate:fresh` without the developer's explicit request.
- Put personal data, amounts or credentials in documents, tests or chat.
- Mark a scenario passed without evidence, or sign on behalf of a stakeholder.

## Working method
- Start in plan mode: restate the task in 5 bullets, list the files you will touch, list open questions; wait for approval.
- Implement in small steps; after each step run the narrowest relevant tests.
- Run `vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent` after PHP changes.
- If you discover a durable rule or trap, record it with the Boost `record-rule` tool (not native memory).
- Do not commit, push, or run destructive commands (`migrate:fresh`, seeders that reset roles, deleting storage) unless the developer asks.
- Never run anything against production.
- Stay inside this task's scope; note anything else as a follow-up.

## Report back
Your final message must contain:
- a summary and the files created or changed;
- migrations added (none expected);
- the gate commands run, with pass/fail counts and the failing test names;
- the DoD gaps found, with which ones you closed and which you logged;
- the defect count by severity and owning task;
- the decisions assumed (persona roles vs the signed matrix, D-15, D-16, D-23, D-29, D-30, D-31, D-32, D-33);
- follow-ups;
- the handoff for Task 29: the Go/No-Go status at CP6 (full or phased release under R9, with the modules whose permissions stay withheld), the open defects with severity, the UAT signature status, the staging topology tested (queue, broadcast, scheduler), and any smoke checks Task 29 must repeat on production.

Implementation scope

  • الحزمة الكاملة php artisan test --compact، وvendor/bin/phpstan، وvendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent.
  • سيناريوهات UAT لكل شخصية:
    1. مدير المشاريع والتمويل: مشروع (مركز) ← مذكرة بخطتها ← مراجعة ← إرسال ← مقترح ← اعتماد ← التحقق من توليد الأشهر وإزاحة الخطة.
    2. MEAL: Indicator Library ← Logical Framework ← مستهدفات لكل مركز ← تحقق شهري ← Monthly Matrix.
    3. المالية: اتفاقية ← سجل التحويل المولَّد آليًا ← إكمال المبلغ المستلم والعمولة وسعر الصرف.
    4. مدير مركز: تأكيد الاستلام ← Monthly Report ← Request Reopen.
    5. الإعلام والمالية: مهمة القسم في خطة المقترح ← تنبيه قبل أسبوع ← تسليم ← قبول.
    6. مدير المشاريع والتمويل: تقرير تجميعي ربعي ونصفي لمقترح بعدة مراكز ← حفظ ← تسليم بملف.
    7. MEAL والإدارة: كل حركة في السيناريوهات السابقة وصلتهم (فوريًا أو في الملخص اليومي)، دون تكرار.
    8. مشروع داخل مركز: محاولة مشروع ثانٍ مفتوح للمركز والبرنامج نفسيهما مرفوضة، وبرنامج آخر في المركز نفسه مقبول، ومقترح التجديد على المشروع نفسه، والمشروع المغلق يعود مسودة بلا تواريخ عند ربط مقترح جديد به.

## Role and goal
You are preparing Task 29 of the HC Tracking proposal-lifecycle correction plan: a safe production deployment with a known maintenance window, 48 hours of monitoring, and clear rollback criteria. You are a preparer and reviewer:
- you turn Task 27's runbook into a final deployment checklist with exact commands and the timings measured in the rehearsal;
- you write the production smoke tests, the monitoring plan, the deploy log and monitoring report templates, and the user announcement;
- you check readiness locally.

You never connect to production, never read or print secrets, and never execute a deployment step. Dev 1 runs every step, with Dev 2 as backup. This is the moment the corrected story goes live: draft projects without dates, the server-enforced proposal stages, approval activating projects, one agreement per proposal with its auto-generated transfer record, project = HR center, MEAL library, logframe, monthly reports generated at activation, aggregated donor reports, department tasks in the proposal plan, notifications to MEAL and General Management for every movement, and encrypted files. A missed step can lose files (the encryption key) or wipe role edits (the wrong seeder).

### Out of scope

## Business rules
- Do not deploy without a backup whose restore has been verified, without the key saved in two off-server places, or with Go missing.
- Rollback criteria (plan): a migration failure, a systematic decryption error, or a broken approval path. Roll back with the backup, following the runbook.
- Acceptance: the system works, there are 0 critical errors in 48 hours, and every file is encrypted (Task 27's POST check on stored file rows with `encryption_key_id IS NULL` returns 0).
- `APP_DEBUG=false` (enforced by `ProductionDebugModeTest`), HTTPS only (`HttpsOnlyTest`), and keys in `.env` only.
- Never deploy on a Friday without monitoring. Never delete the backup before monitoring ends.

## Security and authorization
- Never `cat .env`, never run `config:show` on a key, and never paste secrets into the log, the documents or chat. The developer generates `FILE_ENCRYPTION_KEY` on the server before the first encrypted write, never twice. A second key after encryption means data loss.
- Never run `key:generate` on production. Rotating APP_KEY breaks `users.two_factor_*`, the `accounts` banking columns and sessions; the supported rotation is `security:reencrypt` with `APP_PREVIOUS_KEYS`.
- Check the production `.env` values by name only, with the developer reading them out:
  - `APP_ENV=production`, `APP_DEBUG=false`, `APP_URL` over https;
  - `SESSION_EXPIRE_ON_CLOSE=true`;
  - `REVERB_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` not `*`;
  - `AUTH_TWO_FACTOR_ENFORCED` unchanged;
  - `TRUSTED_PROXIES` unchanged;
  - a non-root DB user;
  - mail configured.
- Smoke tests create no business records and expose no amounts in screenshots that are shared.

## Validation
No user input. Validate the checklist:
- every command exists in `php artisan list` with the flags shown (check `php artisan down --help` and `migrate --help` locally);
- every step has an owner, an expected output, a duration and a rollback pointer;
- every page in the smoke list exists in `php artisan route:list`.

## Edge cases and concurrency
- **HR unreachable during the deploy.** Migrations are unaffected. `SyncProgramsFromHr` reports the error and login fails, so postpone the login smoke tests and keep the site in maintenance or announce the delay.
- **A migration fails midway.** Stop. Do not re-run blindly. Restore and roll back.
- **`files:encrypt-existing` stops.** Re-run it; it is idempotent. Systematic failures are a rollback trigger.
- **Encryption runs past the window.** Use Task 27's decision.
- **Users in the middle of a session.** They see the 503 page; after `up`, a stale Livewire snapshot asks them to refresh. Say so in the announcement.
- **The first scheduled scans after `up`** may send many new alerts (monthly report due, department tasks, donor report owners, logframe missing, project start/end, the grouped `monthly_reports.generated` from the backfill). The ledger prevents duplicates. Warn MEAL and the managers.
- **Mail fails.** In-app notifications are still delivered; retries depend on the topology.
- **Scheduled tasks during `down`.** They skip, because they do not use `evenInMaintenanceMode`. Check that the 03:00 `files:prune` does not overlap the encryption run.
- **Rollback after users have entered data.** That data is lost. Define the cut-off after which a forward fix is the default.

## Data integrity
- Back up after `down`, so the final backup holds every write.
- Run Task 27's POST checks after migration and after encryption (the operator runs them; you interpret the pasted counts).
- Compare the counts of tables the release must not change, before and after.
- Keep the backups and the key copies through monitoring and sign-off.

## Implementation guidance
- Use placeholders (`<app-path>`, `<backup-dir>`, `<release-tag>`, `<deployer-email>`) and never real hosts, users or paths.
- Format the checklist with `- [ ]` items and tables, so the operator ticks steps live. Put the rehearsal durations next to the matching steps, and the total window at the top.
- Find the decryption-error log message and the new command flags in the code (`grep` in `app/Support/StoredFiles.php` and `app/Console/Commands/`); never guess them.
- If you add the schedule entry, keep the style of the existing `routes/console.php` lines.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The deployment document exists with all eight sections, the announcements in Arabic and English, and the templates.
- [ ] Every command and flag is verified locally, and every step carries the rehearsal duration and a rollback pointer.
- [ ] `schedule:list` locally includes `reports:monthly-digest`, Task 21's daily scanner and `monthly-reports:prepare`, with passing schedule tests.
- [ ] The checklist names the Team A on-call for Saturday 2026-10-31 and Sunday 2026-11-01, and documents both the full and the phased (R9) release.
- [ ] The rollback triggers have thresholds and an owner, and the procedure restores the DB and storage together.
- [ ] The local readiness tests pass, and the precondition gate records Go or No-Go explicitly.

## Do not
- Run anything against production, or ask for access, credentials or `.env` contents.
- Run `RolesAndPermissionsSeeder`, `db:seed`, `migrate:fresh`, `key:generate`, or `migrate --graceful`.
- Skip `--dry-run`, deploy on a Friday without monitoring, or delete backups or key copies before sign-off.
- Change application code beyond the approved schedule entry, or schedule `files:encrypt-existing`.
- Put secrets, personal data or amounts in documents or chat.

## Working method
- Start in plan mode: restate the task in 5 bullets, list the files you will touch, list open questions; wait for approval.
- Implement in small steps; after each step run the narrowest relevant tests.
- Run `vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent` after PHP changes.
- If you discover a durable rule or trap, record it with the Boost `record-rule` tool (not native memory).
- Do not commit, push, or run destructive commands (`migrate:fresh`, seeders that reset roles, deleting storage) unless the developer asks.
- Never run anything against production.
- Stay inside this task's scope; note anything else as a follow-up.

## Report back
Your final message must contain:
- a summary and the files created or changed;
- migrations added (none expected);
- the local tests and checks run, with pass/fail output;
- the Go/No-Go precondition status;
- the topology assumed;
- the decisions assumed (D-19, D-21, D-22, D-29, D-30, encryption inside or after the window, full or phased release);
- open risks and follow-ups (to the maintenance list);
- the close-out handoff: the deploy-log and monitoring-report paths, the backup retention date, the key-custody confirmation still needed, and the defects moved to maintenance. Nothing depends on this task after it; it closes the project.

## Role and goal
You are implementing Task 24 of the HC Tracking proposal-lifecycle correction plan in this Laravel 13 / Livewire 4 / Flux UI 2 repository. The outcome: an annual plan has a status (`draft` → `approved`, with approver and date), and the program/branch manager lists the activities the plan will deliver — picked from the program's results framework (type `activity`) with planned months, like the Gantt template's "Planned / Implemented" rows — next to the targets MEAL enters. "Implemented" is derived from the milestones linked to each activity (Task 12), never typed. The **Annual Plan** page then answers "which indicators and activities must be achieved, and which milestones reached" in a draft or approved state. The 8 existing plans become `approved` so **Executive Summary** figures do not move. No other task depends on this one.

## Business rules
- New plans start `draft`; the migration marks every existing plan `approved` (approver NULL, shown "Approved (before workflow)" — confirm `approved_at` NULL vs migration time).
- Draft: targets and activities are editable by their permission holders. Approved: read-only; a change first needs **Return to Draft** with a reason (≥ 10 chars) recorded in the **Activity Log** with the actor. Raise the alternative (edit prompts for a reason and reverts automatically) in plan mode.
- Activities come only from the plan's program framework: `results.type = 'activity'`, `results.program_id = annual_plans.program_id`, `results.proposal_id IS NULL`.
- `planned_months`: distinct integers 1–12, stored sorted, at least one.
- Implemented months are derived: a month of the plan year is implemented when a non-cancelled milestone linked to the activity (`milestones.result_id`), in a project of the plan's program, has an actual period (`actual_start_date` → `actual_end_date` or today) overlapping it. Confirm the definition in plan mode; read it in one query for the whole tab.
- **Approve**: only from `draft`; the approver is not the activities' preparer (D-18); sets `approved_by` and `approved_at`. A plan without activities or targets can be approved with a warning (confirm).
- **Executive Summary** (D-18 default): figures include all plans as today; draft plans are marked (e.g. "2 drafts" on the coverage card). Existing plans being `approved` keeps every number unchanged.

## Security and authorization
- Activities: `Gate::authorize('update', $plan)` inside `SaveAnnualPlanActivities` (`annual-plans.update`, plan manager or program manager), plus status `draft`.
- Targets: unchanged `targets.*` (MEAL), plus the draft guard in the server path that writes annual-plan targets.
- Approve: `AnnualPlanPolicy::approve()` = `annual-plans.update` and not the preparer; `Gate::authorize('approve', $plan)` inside `ApproveAnnualPlan`.
- Return to draft: `Gate::authorize('update', $plan)`.
- Object level: activities load through `$plan->activities()->whereKey($ids)`; result ids load through the program-framework query above with `whereKey($ids)`. Any foreign id rejects the whole batch. `status`, `approved_by`, `approved_at`, `prepared_by` are never read from the request.
- Repeat each check at the top of the Livewire method so `AuthorizationCoverageTest` sees it; data helpers stay `protected` (`BrowserCallableMethodsTest`). No money is involved.

## Validation
Messages in `lang/ar/annual_plans.php` and `lang/en/annual_plans.php`:
- `activities.*.result_id`: required, integer, an activity of this plan's program — «اختر نشاطًا من إطار برنامج هذه الخطة» / "Choose an activity from this plan's program framework"; duplicates in the batch — «النشاط مضاف إلى الخطة مسبقًا» / "This activity is already in the plan".
- `activities.*.planned_months`: required, array, min:1; each integer between 1 and 12, distinct — «اختر شهرًا واحدًا على الأقل بين 1 و12 دون تكرار» / "Pick at least one month between 1 and 12, without repeats".
- `activities.*.notes`: nullable, string, max:2000.
- `returnReason`: required, string, min:10, max:1000 — «اكتب سببًا لا يقل عن 10 أحرف» / "Give a reason of at least 10 characters".
- Server invariants (`ValidationException::withMessages()` from the Actions): approved plan edited — «الخطة معتمدة. أعدها مسودة بسبب قبل التعديل.»; approve a non-draft — «الخطة معتمدة مسبقًا»; approver is the preparer — «لا يمكن أن يعتمد الخطة من أعدّ أنشطتها»; stale set — «عُدّلت أنشطة الخطة من مستخدم آخر، أعد التحميل.» — each with an English equivalent.

## Edge cases and concurrency
- Double **Approve**: lock the plan (`lockForUpdate`) and expect `draft`; the second call gets the message and writes nothing.
- Approve while activities are being saved: both Actions lock the plan row first, then its activities (fixed lock order).
- Stale activity set: the form sends the ids it loaded; reject the batch if the locked set differs; disable buttons with `wire:loading`.
- Deleting a framework activity linked to a plan: refused with a message in `canDelete()` (the FK `restrictOnDelete` is the backstop); changing its type or moving it to another program while linked: refused (propose where: page guard or `ResultObserver`).
- Reassigning a plan to another program (`savePlan()`, `reassign`) while it has activities: refuse with a message (propose).
- Deleting a plan cascades its activities; `PlanIndicatorSourceObserver` still deletes its targets. Deleting a program: verify `ProgramObserver` deletes plans (and their activities) before results, so the restrict FK never fires.
- Plans without activities keep Task 16's fallback view; plans with activities show their own list.

## Data integrity
- Migration 1 order: count rows → add columns → backfill `status = 'approved'` for all existing rows (query builder, one statement) → verify no `draft` among pre-existing ids → add FKs. MySQL does not roll back DDL: keep `up()` re-runnable or fail before DDL. `down()` drops FKs then columns.
- Migration 2: new table, `down()` drops it. `planned_months` json passes `DatabaseEncodingTest` (MariaDB json = `utf8mb4_bin` with a `json_valid` check, by design).
- Every write in one `DB::transaction` with the lock; saving activities = delete removed, update kept, insert new, record one activity.
- The four reads of `annual_plans` on the matrix stay four: add `status` to the existing plan-cell select; never a fifth query. **Executive Summary** draft counts ride existing queries (add `status` to `plansOf()`, conditional aggregate for the card).

## Implementation guidance
- `declare(strict_types=1);`, `#[Fillable]` (`['result_id', 'planned_months', 'notes']` on the activity), `casts()` (`'planned_months' => 'array'`, `status` → `AnnualPlanStatus::class`, `approved_at` → `datetime`), CarbonImmutable docblocks, array-shape PHPDoc.
- `php artisan make:migration … --no-interaction`, `php artisan make:model AnnualPlanActivity --factory --no-interaction`, `php artisan make:enum AnnualPlanStatus --no-interaction` (if available; else `make:class`). Factories omit default-bearing columns; add an `approved()` state on `AnnualPlanFactory` as a per-attribute closure.
- Tabs follow `proposals/⚡show` (`TABS` constant + `updatedTab()` guard). Status chip in the `x-ui.detail-header` meta slot with text and icon, not colour alone. Flux modals bound with `wire:model`, never `:open`. Month toggles have accessible labels (localized month names); grid keyboard-navigable; logical classes only.
```php
final class ApproveAnnualPlan
{
    public function handle(AnnualPlan $plan): void
    {
        Gate::authorize('approve', $plan);

        DB::transaction(function () use ($plan): void {
            $locked = AnnualPlan::query()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($plan->id);
            // expect draft; approver ≠ prepared_by; set status, approved_by, approved_at; record activity
        });
    }
}
```

Implementation scope

  • واجهة في صفحة Annual Plan: تبويب Activities (مدير الفرع/البرنامج) بجانب المستهدفات (MEAL)، وزر Approve.

Business rules

  • المسودة: المستهدفات والأنشطة قابلة للتعديل. المعتمدة: تعديلها يعيدها مسودة بسبب.
  • الأنشطة من إطار برنامج الخطة فقط، ومن نوع activity.

## Role and goal
You are implementing Task 25 of the HC Tracking proposal-lifecycle correction plan: budget lines per proposal, split across Finance's five categories (HR, Operational, Fixed, Running, Activity — the "study lines"). The outcome: on the **Proposal** page, a holder of money permissions enters lines per category in the proposal's own currency and sees their total against the requested budget (`proposals.requested_budget`, Task 03) and, once the agreement exists, against the agreement budget (`donor_proposal.budget`, Task 09). In the corrected story the concept note carries an estimated budget, the proposal is drafted, reviewed internally and submitted to the donor; the breakdown belongs to that preparation, so it freezes at `submitted` and reopens only when the proposal returns to `proposal draft`. This is money data: nobody without money permissions may query, see or change it.

## Scope
### In scope
- Create migration `create_budget_lines_table`: `id`, `proposal_id` (`constrained()->cascadeOnDelete()`), `category` varchar(50), `description` varchar(255), `amount` decimal(14,2), timestamps, index (`proposal_id`, `category`). No currency column: the currency is the proposal's `requested_currency`.
- Create `App\Enums\BudgetCategory` (string-backed, `HasTranslatedLabel`, `values()`): `Hr = 'hr'`, `Operational = 'operational'`, `Fixed = 'fixed'`, `Running = 'running'`, `Activity = 'activity'`.
- Create `App\Models\BudgetLine` + `BudgetLineFactory` (`php artisan make:model BudgetLine --factory --no-interaction`); add `Proposal::budgetLines(): HasMany`.
- Update `ProposalStatus` with `allowsBudgetLineEdits(): bool` (exhaustive `match`, no `default`).
- Create `App\Actions\Proposals\SaveProposalBudgetLines` (bulk save of the whole set).
- Update every writer of `requested_currency` (`SaveProposal`, and `TransitionProposal` if it writes it) to refuse a change while lines exist; prefer one shared guard used by all writers.
- Update `resources/views/pages/proposals/⚡show.blade.php`: a **Budget Lines** section. Decide placement in plan mode: inside the money-gated `funding` tab, or a new `budget` tab added to `TABS` with the same guard in `updatedTab()`.
- Lang: `lang/{en,ar}/proposals.php` (section copy, messages, warnings), `lang/{en,ar}/enums.php` (`budget_category.*`), `lang/{en,ar}/notifications.php` (`events.proposal.budget_lines_updated`).
- Seed a few lines in `database/seeders/FinanceSeeder.php`; add `BudgetLine` to `tests/Feature/DatabaseSeederTest.php` and to `modelsGuardedWithoutPolicy()` in `tests/Feature/AccessControl/PolicyCoverageTest.php` (module `proposals`, with the reason).
### Out of scope
- Budget lines on funding pages, **Executive Summary**, exports or the proposal directory (any such money figure must first be defined in `App\Support\AgreementMoney`).
- Copying lines in `CloneProposalForRenewal` (Task 10) — follow-up only.
- Changing `requested_budget` rules (Tasks 03/06), the transition table (Task 04) or agreement rules (Task 09). Currency conversion of any kind.

## Business rules
- Exactly five categories (`BudgetCategory`); several lines per category; each line has a description and an amount.
- Line currency = the proposal's `requested_currency`. While it is null, no line can be saved.
- Lines total ≠ `requested_budget`: show a warning with both figures; never block a save or a transition. No requested budget: show the total and "no requested budget recorded".
- Agreement comparison: compute a difference only when `donor_proposal.currency` equals `requested_currency` (read it through the `DonorProposal` model, not a pivot: see the pivot-currency trap in `.ai/rules/enums.md`); otherwise show both figures, each with its currency, and say they are not compared. Never add, convert or net amounts across currencies.
- Editable while status ∈ {`concept note`, `concept note review`, `concept note submitted`, `proposal draft`, `proposal review`}; locked for `submitted`, `on hold`, `approved`, `active`, `final reports`, `completed`, `rejected`. `submitted → proposal draft` (Task 04) reopens them. Confirm the `concept note submitted` reading in plan mode.
- Changing `requested_currency` while lines exist is refused with a field message, from every writer.
- Subtotals per category and the total come from SQL `SUM(amount)` (or decimal-safe arithmetic), never float accumulation; display through `x-ui.money` with the proposal currency.

## Security and authorization
- View: the shared money predicate. For everyone else the computed property returns nothing **without querying** `budget_lines`, and the section is not rendered (`.ai/rules/pages.md`, "Hide money, keep names"; `@can` alone is not enough).
- Edit: `Gate::authorize('update', $proposal)` (`proposals.update` via `ProposalPolicy`) **and** the money predicate, both inside `SaveProposalBudgetLines`, repeated at the top of the Livewire method so `AuthorizationCoverageTest` sees a check. A Public Relations Manager holds `proposals.update` but no money permission: 403.
- Object level: resolve the proposal from the page's locked id; load existing lines only via `$proposal->budgetLines()->whereKey($ids)`. Any line id that does not belong to this proposal rejects the whole batch.
- `#[Fillable(['category', 'description', 'amount'])]`; `proposal_id` is never read from input (create through the relation).
- Audit: one `proposal.budget_lines_updated` activity per save via `$proposal->recordActivity()`, properties = line counts per category, no amounts. If `ProposalRecipients` would notify a watcher without money permission (Public Relations Manager), keep the event out of notifications and explain how in the plan.
- Page helpers that return data stay `protected` (`BrowserCallableMethodsTest`).

## Validation
Messages go to `lang/ar/proposals.php` and `lang/en/proposals.php`:
- `lines`: present, array, max:200 (confirm the cap in plan mode).
- `lines.*.id`: nullable, integer (ownership enforced in the Action).
- `lines.*.category`: required, `new Enum(BudgetCategory::class)` — «اختر فئة البند» / "Choose the line's category".
- `lines.*.description`: required, string, max:255 — «اكتب وصف البند» / "Describe the line".
- `lines.*.amount`: required, numeric, min:0, max:999999999999.99 — «المبلغ لا يكون سالبًا» / "An amount cannot be negative".
- Server-side invariants thrown from the Action with `ValidationException::withMessages()`: currency missing «حدّد عملة المقترح أولًا»; status lock «بنود الميزانية مقفلة بعد تقديم المقترح للمانح. أعد المقترح مسودة لتعديلها.»; stale set «عُدّلت بنود الميزانية من مستخدم آخر، أعد التحميل.»; currency lock on `requestedCurrency` «لا يمكن تغيير عملة المقترح ما دامت له بنود ميزانية.» — each with an English equivalent.

## Edge cases and concurrency
- Double submit and two editors: the form sends the ids it loaded (`expectedLineIds`); inside the transaction lock the proposal and its lines (`lockForUpdate`) and reject the batch if the current id set differs. A repeated click after a successful save then fails gracefully instead of duplicating new rows; also disable the button with `wire:loading`.
- Status or currency changed between load and save: re-check `allowsBudgetLineEdits()` and `requested_currency` after the lock.
- Money permission revoked mid-edit: save → 403; the next render hides the section.
- **Correct Status** (Super Admin) moves a terminal status: the lock follows the new status.
- Deleting every line is allowed while editable. Proposal deletion cascades lines (a proposal with an agreement cannot be deleted: `donor_proposal.proposal_id` RESTRICT).
- Partial failure: any invalid row rolls back the whole batch.

## Data integrity
- One `DB::transaction` per save: lock proposal → lock lines → verify ids, status, currency → delete removed → update kept → insert new → record activity. Any notification `afterCommit`.
- FK `budget_lines.proposal_id` cascade; table and columns `utf8mb4_unicode_ci` on InnoDB DYNAMIC (`DatabaseEncodingTest`). New empty table: no data pre-check; `down()` drops it.

## Implementation guidance
- `declare(strict_types=1);`, `casts()` (`category` → `BudgetCategory::class`, `amount` → `'decimal:2'`), `@property` docblocks with `CarbonImmutable`, array-shape PHPDoc.
- Flux modal (if used) bound with `wire:model="showBudgetLinesModal"`, never `:open`; reuse `x-ui.money`, `x-ui.panel`, Flux inputs; logical classes only (`ms-*`, `pe-*`, `text-start`); amounts `tabular-nums`. Labels via `$case->label()`; stored values stay English. Full `@php … @endphp` blocks only.
```php
final class SaveProposalBudgetLines
{
    /**
     * @param  list<array{id: int|null, category: string, description: string, amount: string}>  $lines
     * @param  list<int>  $expectedLineIds  ids the form loaded
     */
    public function handle(Proposal $proposal, array $lines, array $expectedLineIds): void
    {
        Gate::authorize('update', $proposal);
        // + the shared money predicate (abort 403 when missing)
        DB::transaction(function () use ($proposal, $lines, $expectedLineIds): void {
            // lock, verify, apply, record one activity
        });
    }
}
```

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Finance sees, per proposal, the split across the five categories with subtotals and a total in the proposal currency.
- [ ] A total different from the requested budget warns and never blocks; cross-currency figures are never combined or compared.
- [ ] Lines are locked from `submitted` on and reopen only after a return to `proposal draft`.
- [ ] A currency change is refused while lines exist, from every writer.
- [ ] Without money permissions: no `budget_lines` query, no amount in the HTML, 403 on save.
- [ ] All new text exists in Arabic and English; listed tests pass; Pint clean.

## Do not
- Add, convert or net amounts across currencies; store a currency per line.
- Read `proposal_id`, the status or the currency from the request.
- Rely on hidden buttons or Blade `@can` for money hiding.
- Save a batch partially.
- Put amounts in activity properties, notifications or tour copy.
- Use `:open` on `flux:modal`, the `@php(...)` shorthand, or physical `ml-/mr-/left-/right-` classes.
- Add dependencies or touch funding-page money definitions outside `AgreementMoney`.

## Working method
- Start in plan mode: restate the task in 5 bullets, list files you will touch, list open questions (D-17 status, section placement, `concept note submitted` lock, line cap, notification fan-out); wait for approval.
- Implement in small steps; after each step run the narrowest relevant tests.
- Run `vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent` after PHP changes.
- If you discover a durable rule or trap, record it with the Boost `record-rule` tool (not native memory).
- Do not commit, push, or run destructive commands (`migrate:fresh`, seeders that reset roles, deleting storage) unless the developer asks.
- Never run anything against production.
- Stay inside Task 25's scope; note anything else as a follow-up.

## Report back
- Summary; files created/changed; migration added; tests run with pass/fail output.
- Decisions assumed: D-17 approval reference, section placement, lock statuses, line cap, notification handling.
- Follow-ups: renewal cloning (Task 10), funding-page display through `AgreementMoney`, anything found in Tasks 03/06.
- Handoff: no task depends on Task 25. For the Task 26 run (`TASK_NUMBER` = 25) list the new lang keys, the page/tab and any data hooks; for Task 28 (Finance UAT scenario) state the permission rule, the lock rule and where the section lives.

Objective

الإجابة عن سؤال «كم أنجزنا من مستهدف الاستراتيجية لسنة 2026؟» لكل محور، من بيانات النظام لا من عرض PowerPoint.

Implementation scope (ملخص)

  • الأهداف الاستراتيجية: strategic_objectives، أي 3 إلى 4 أهداف لكل محور (مثل «استدامة المشاريع وتنافسيتها»، «تعزيز التحصيل الأكاديمي»). يُربط بها جذر Impact في إطار البرنامج.
  • المستهدفات الاستراتيجية: strategic_targets بالأعمدة pillar_id، program_id (nullable)، library_indicator_id، scope_filter (مثل المسار الحضري أو الريفي)، year، target، unit. تُستورد من strategy-2026-2030.json.
  • لوحة Strategy Scorecard: لكل محور وسنة، المستهدف والمحقَّق ونسبة الإنجاز.
    • المحقَّق = تجميع التقارير المعتمدة لكل المستهدفات التي يرتبط مؤشرها بمدخلة المكتبة نفسها، في برامج المحور، خلال السنة.
    • التجميع عبر achievedValueSql() وpooledRatioSql()، لا معادلة محلية.
  • ربط الخطة السنوية (Task 24): مستهدف البرنامج السنوي في الخطة يُقترح من المستهدف الاستراتيجي لتلك السنة.

ما يحتاج قرارًا قبلها

  • «20 جلسة دعم جماعي / 1,800 طفل»: مستهدفان في خانة واحدة.

بيانات HR (الكتابة والحساسية)تعديل HR من النظام، أو قراءة الرواتب وتفاصيل العقودHrModel يرفض save/delete (اختبار)، وselect صريح بلا أعمدة الراتب والعقد في EmployeeProfile
التوليد الآليتكرار الأشهر أو التحويلات عند تكرار الحدث أو إعادة المحاولةفهارس فريدة، ومستمعون idempotent، والإطلاق بعد الالتزام
مهام الأقسامموظف يرى مهام قسم آخر أو مال المقترحشرط القسم من HR داخل TaskVisibilityScope، والصفحة بلا مال، واختبار عدم توسيع الرؤية
التقرير التجميعيأرقام غير متحقق منها، أو مال لغير المالية، أو تقرير مسلَّم يتغيرالمتحقق منه فقط، ولقطة مجمّدة، والقسم المالي يُستعلم لحاملي الصلاحية فقط
العمل مع فريق ثانٍشيفرة غير مراجعة، أو وصول للإنتاج، أو تسريب بيانات حقيقيةمراجعة إلزامية من Dev 1/Dev 2، ولا وصول للإنتاج، وبيانات مموّهة للتطوير
Mass assignmentحقن حقول (status, donor_id)#[Fillable] محدد، والحالة والمانح لا يُقرآن من الطلب في الـ Actions
المفاتيح والأسرارتسريب FILE_ENCRYPTION_KEY.env فقط، و.env.example بلا قيمة، وفحص gitleaks في CI
الأوامر المجدولةتشغيل مزدوجwithoutOverlapping() وonOneServer() + ledger

جدول التنفيذ المتوازي

افتراض أسبوع العمل: الاثنين–الجمعة (D-22). Dev 3 بنسبة توفر ≈ 40%، و«—» تعني أنه غير متاح ذلك اليوم. السبت 2026-10-31 نهاية الشهر: لا عمل، مناوب فقط.

Definition of Done

المتطلبات الوظيفية

  • المشروع يُنشأ مسودة بلا تواريخ، ويتفعّل فقط باعتماد مقترح وتأكيد المالك.
  • المقترح بمانح واحد ومشروع واحد على الأقل، ومراحل المذكرة والمقترح يفرضها الخادم مع الحقول الإلزامية لكل انتقال.
  • اتفاقية واحدة لكل مقترح، ولمقترح معتمد فقط.
  • حلقة المراجعة بمعنيين افتراضيين وإضافيين وMark as Seen وملاحظة.
  • Indicator Library، وLogical Framework بأربعة مستويات في المقترح، والمستهدفات لكل مركز، والسلسلة الكاملة.
  • البرامج مربوطة بالمحاور الاستراتيجية، وإطار Micro المعياري مستورد، ويبدأ منه المقترح (Task 32).
  • النسب والمتوسطات تُدخل بالبسط والمقام، وتُجمَّع بـ pooledRatioSql() وحده في Monthly Matrix والتقرير التجميعي، والتقرير الشهري يعرض المؤشرات المستحقة فقط.
  • التقرير الشهري بالتسلسل والقفل والتحقق وإعادة الفتح، وMonthly Matrix.
  • المشروع مربوط بمركز HR وبرنامج، ومشروع مفتوح واحد لكل مركز وبرنامج، والتجديد مقترح جديد على المشروع نفسه.
  • المقترح يحمل منذ إنشائه إطاره ومؤشراته ومستهدفاته ومراحله ومهام قسمَي الإعلام والمالية، وتُزاح التواريخ عند الاعتماد.
  • التفعيل يولّد أشهر التقرير الشهري، والاتفاقية تولّد سجل التحويل، دون تكرار.
  • التقرير التجميعي للمانح لأي فترة (ربعي، نصفي، سنوي، مخصص)، يُحفظ ويُصدَّر ويُسلَّم.
  • التقرير الشهري يميّز بنود MEAL عن بنود المدير (D-48)، ويحوي قسم أنشطة الشهر حسب الرزنامة، وتأكيد MEAL يحدّث حالة النشاط في المشروع (D-49).
  • المؤشر المشترك بين مانحين يتبع نمط برنامجه (D-46): في split حصة لكل مانح ومجموعها إنجاز المركز، وفي shared القيمة كاملة لكل مانح دون مضاعفة في مجاميع المركز.
  • كتالوج الأحداث مطبّق: كل حركة تصل لـ MEAL والإدارة والمعنيين، وEventCatalogCoverageTest يمر، والملخص الشهري وإشعارات البداية والنهاية والتذكير تعمل.
  • بيانات الموظف (المنصب الحالي، المستوى، القسم، البرنامج، المركز، المدينة) تُقرأ من HR فقط.

التفويض

  • كل Action يستدعي Gate::authorize، ولكل نموذج جديد Policy.
  • اختبار 403 لكل إجراء جديد، واختبار BOLA لكل إجراء يستقبل معرّفًا فرعيًا.
  • لا مال يظهر لمن لا يملك صلاحياته، ويُتحقق في الاستعلام لا في العرض فقط.

التحقق

  • كل قاعدة تحقق في الخطة مطبّقة في الخادم برسالة مترجمة.

سلامة البيانات

  • القيود الفريدة والمفاتيح الأجنبية والمركبة موجودة ومختبرة.
  • كل انتقال حالة في معاملة مع قفل، وكل عملية جماعية ذرية.
  • الأوامر idempotent ولها --dry-run.

الاختبارات

  • اختبارات Pest لكل مهمة: نجاح، تحقق، صلاحية، انتقال، تزامن، حالات حدية.
  • الحزمة الكاملة php artisan test --compact خضراء، وPHPStan بلا أخطاء جديدة، وPint نظيف.
  • كل مهمة تطلق أحداثها، وأحداثها مسجّلة في كتالوج Task 21.
  • كل PR من الفريق B مراجَع ومدموج قبل CP5.
  • اختبارات عدد الاستعلامات الثابت للصفحات الثقيلة (Logical Framework، Indicator Library، Monthly Matrix، الشبكة).

التوطين

  • كل النصوص في lang/ar وlang/en، ولا نص حرفي، والصفحات الجديدة سليمة بالاتجاهين.

إمكانية الوصول

  • الشبكات قابلة للتنقل بلوحة المفاتيح، والحقول لها تسميات، والتباين سليم بالمظهرين، والحالات لا تُنقل باللون وحده.

سجل التدقيق

  • كل نموذج جديد يسجّل نشاطه في Activity Log (activities)، والحالات لها قيود غير قابلة للتعديل بفاعل وتاريخ وسبب.

التوثيق

  • سجل القرارات، والقواعد المحدثة في .ai/rules، ودليل المستخدم بالعربية والإنجليزية، والـ runbook.

جاهزية النشر

  • البروفة ناجحة على نسخة الإنتاج، والتراجع مجرَّب، والمفتاح محفوظ خارج الخادم، والأوامر المجدولة مسجلة، وUAT موقّع.

القرارات المفتوحة

#القرارالأثرالافتراضي الموصى به
D-01هل يوجد اعتماد داخلي (المجلس أو الإدارة) قبل إرسال المقترح للمانح؟ ومن يملك Approve Proposal في النظام؟يضيف حالة وبوابة، ويغيّر صلاحية ApproveProposalالافتراضي (ورشة 2026-10-12): المراجعة الداخلية كافية بلا بوابة مجلس. الرئيس التنفيذي ومدير المشاريع والتمويل يراجعان المقترح قبل الإرسال، فتُضاف خانة CEO إلى Default Proposal Reviewers (Task 07)
D-02الإبقاء على الحالة final reports؟ (لم ترد في صورة الحالات)إزالتها تمس الخط الزمني والماسحاتمحسوم (المراجعة 6 و8): تُلغى الحالة. التقرير الختامي معلَم يُضاف يدويًا من قالب (D-02a). يُمنع completed قبل اكتمال المعلَم ورفع ملف التقرير الختامي في النظام وتسجيل PR لموافقة الممول (D-02b، D-02c). بريد القبول اختياري
D-03هل يجوز تخطي المذكرة المفاهيمية لمانح لا يطلبها؟منع التخطي يعطّل حالات حقيقيةالافتراضي (ورشة 2026-10-12): التخطي مسموح بسبب مكتوب، مثل وجود مقترح جاهز مسبقًا
D-04الاعتماد يفعّل المشروع فورًا، أم يبقى «معتمدًا» حتى تاريخ البدء؟يمس العدسات والتنبيهاتمحسوم (المراجعة 6 و8): البدء = تاريخ بدء المقترح، وينزاح إلى تاريخ الاعتماد إن تأخر (أو تاريخ لاحق بسبب) (D-04a). المشروع active عند تأكيد MEAL للنموذج، والتقارير من شهر البدء (D-04b)
D-05مشروع بعدة مقترحات معتمدة: كيف تُحسب تواريخه؟تواريخ المشروع والجانتالافتراضي (ورشة 2026-10-12) + جانت لكل مقترح وجانت كلي. فجوة بين مقترحين: المشروع يبقى active، والتقارير الشهرية تستمر لأنها للمؤسسة لا للمانح
D-06مشروع رُفض مقترحه الوحيد: ماذا يحدث له؟يبقى في المحفظة المفتوحةمحسوم (المراجعة 8): المقترح وحده rejected في الأرشيف، والمشروع مسودة بشارة «لا يوجد مقترح فعّال»، والأرشفة يدوية
D-07متى يُحتسب التقرير الشهري في الإنجاز: تحقق MEAL أم «نشر» مدير القسم؟تعريف الإنجاز في كل النظامالافتراضي (ورشة 2026-10-12): يُحتسب عند تأكيد MEAL. بعد الإرسال يُقفل التقرير على المدير، وMEAL إما يؤكد أو يعيد بملاحظة
D-08قاعدة التسلسل الشهري: منع الفتح أم منع الإرسال فقط؟مرونة مدير المركزالافتراضي (ورشة 2026-10-12)
D-09من يوافق على إعادة فتح تقرير متحقق منه؟الصلاحية reports.reopenمحسوم (المراجعة 6 و9): شاغل خانة MEAL Manager. عند شغورها: Public Relations Manager (D-09a، المراجعة 9). إن لم يوجد حامل فعّال يُنبَّه الرئيس التنفيذي. D-09b مغلق
D-10رمز المؤشر في المكتبة: إلزامي أم اختياري؟استيراد الجداول القائمةمحسوم (المراجعة 9، D-10a وD-10b): المؤشرات ثابتة لكل برنامج. الرمز رمز_البرنامج.المستوى.تسلسل (مثل 002.OP1.2.3) يولّده الخادم، فريد على مستوى المؤسسة، ومخزّن في المكتبة. المستويات: G وOC وOP وAC وCC، والبادئة HC للمؤسسي. رموز البرامج المكررة في HR تُصحَّح قبل التعبئة

D-39(محسوم، المراجعة 4) متى يصبح المشروع active؟Task 05، 08، 17، 33بعد اعتماد المقترح وتأكيد المالك يصبح approved، ثم active عند تأكيد MEAL لنموذج التقرير. التوليد الآلي للتقارير عند التأكيد
D-40(محسوم، المراجعة 4) المؤشر نفسه لمانحين بمستهدفين مختلفينTask 13، 17، 18، 19، 33بند واحد في التقرير، مستهدفه الأعلى أو رقم يغطي الاثنين يضعه MEAL. القيمة الشهرية تُحتسب كاملة لكل مانح (مرايا reports)، ولا تُجمع المرايا عبر المانحين. عدّلتها D-46: هذا للبرامج shared فقط
D-41(محسوم، المراجعة 4) من أي شهر تظهر مؤشرات مقترح جديد لمشروع نشط؟Task 17، 33خلال مدة المقترح الجديد فقط. لا تُضاف إلى أشهر سابقة لبدايته، ولا يُعاد فتح أي تقرير مُرسَل. إن تأخر التأكيد تظهر في الأشهر المسودة من مدته فقط
D-42(محسوم، المراجعة 4) الملفات الداعمةTask 17، 33لائحة أنواع ثابتة يديرها MEAL (evidence_types). المدير يحدد نوع كل ملف، وMEAL يحدد لكل بند الأنواع الإلزامية، والإرسال يُرفض بدونها
D-43(محسوم، المراجعة 4 و8) شكل الأسئلة السرديةTask 17، 19، 33التقرير شهري دائمًا. بنك أسئلة موحّد للمؤسسة (شهرية، وربعية في آخر شهر من الربع) يُنسخ إلى نموذج كل مشروع، ويعدّله MEAL ويضيف عليه لكل مشروع (D-43a)
D-44(محسوم، المراجعة 4 و9) المؤشرات المؤسسيةTask 33، 24مستهدف سنوي لكل مركز يضعه MEAL، مخزّن كـ plan_indicators مصدره الخطة السنوية للبرنامج. الخطة بالحد الأدنى تُنشأ آليًا لسنة 2026 فقط. من 2027 يُدخل كل مدير برنامج خطته السنوية، وإلا يُرفض المستهدف ويُنبَّه (D-44a)
D-45(محسوم، المراجعة 4) المشاريع النشطة القائمة عند النشرTask 27، 33تبقى active، ونموذج معبّأ مسبقًا من مستهدفاتها ينتظر تأكيد MEAL في طابوره. أسطر تقاريرها لا تظهر حتى التأكيد
D-46(محسوم، المراجعة 5) مؤشر مشترك بين مانحين: هل يُحسب المستفيد لكل ممول أم يُقسَّم بينهم؟ (Micro: 10 = 6 + 4 بتقريرين؛ DESC: 30 للممولَين بتقرير واحد)Task 13، 17، 18، 19، 27، 33النمط صفة للبرنامج (programs.donor_attribution: shared أو split). shared = D-40. split: مدير المركز يُدخل حصة كل مانح شهريًا، ومرآة كل مانح = حصته، وإنجاز المركز = مجموع الحصص، ومستهدف البند = مجموع مستهدفات المانحين. المستفيد له ممول واحد، فلا خانة إجمالي ولا تحقق تطابق
D-47(محسوم، المراجعة 6 و8 و9) وحدة القطاعات (Sectors)Task 34، 02، 05، 27قائمة يديرها MEAL وGM. القائمة الأولية (S-1): الصحة، الأمن الغذائي وسبل العيش، المياه والإصحاح البيئي والنظافة (WASH)، المأوى والمواد غير الغذائية (NFIs)، الحماية، التعليم. قطاع واحد على الأقل إلزامي للمشاريع الجديدة (S-2). الربط بالمشروع فقط (S-3)
D-48(محسوم، المراجعة 7 و9) مؤشرات التقرير الشهري التي يحتسبها MEAL حصرًاTask 17، 27، 33entered_by لكل بند (project_team أو meal)، والافتراضي من المكتبة. بند MEAL للقراءة عند المدير، ولا يمنع الإرسال. يُدخله MEAL أثناء المراجعة وقبل التأكيد، أو يعلّمه «لم يُقس هذا الشهر» (D-48a، مؤكَّد)
D-49(محسوم، المراجعة 7 و8 و9) متابعة رزنامة الأنشطة في التقرير الشهريTask 12، 17، 27، 31، 33أنشطة الإطار المنطقي فقط. المدير يحدد حالة كل نشاط مستحق بحالات Excel (D-51)، وعند تأكيد MEAL تُحدَّث حالة النشاط. رزنامة واحدة للمقترح مع تعديل لمركز (D-49a). الدقة: الشهر والأسبوع، وتاريخ التنفيذ الفعلي في التقرير (D-49b). يضعها MEAL ومحرر المقترح قبل الاعتماد، وMEAL وحده بعده (D-49c)
D-50(محسوم، المراجعة 8) تفصيل المؤشراتTask 11، 17، 18، 19، 27، 33المؤشرات عن الأشخاص (is_disaggregated) تُفصَّل حسب الجنس (ذكور، إناث)، ومنهم ذوو الإعاقة لكل جنس على حدة، في العدد وفي البسط والمقام. المجموع على الخادم. المستهدف يبقى إجماليًا (D-50a، الافتراضي). لا فئات عمرية في نافذة أكتوبر
D-51(محسوم، المراجعة 8) حالات النشاطTask 12، 17، 18، 31حالات Excel: Not Started، Started، Ongoing، Suspended، Cancelled، Completed، وConducted للأحداث. نوع النشاط ممتد أو حدث. النشاط غير المنتهي يُرحَّل آليًا إلى الشهر التالي بلا إعادة جدولة

إجابات الجولة الثانية (المراجعة 9)

أُجيب عن كل الأسئلة المتبقية في المحادثة (2026-10-12). لا قرار مفتوحًا يوقف مهمة في نافذة أكتوبر. D-17 وD-18 مؤجَّلان كما هو موثّق.
